row.name: Watertight
row.detailed_description: Watertight is a short psychological-horror experience set aboard a 1950s deep-sea submarine. FEATURES Solve clever puzzles to restore your submarine’s critical systems Explore the submarine’s cramped, flooded corridors Horror ambience that amplifies claustrophobia A concise, intense experience designed to be finished in 30 minutes THE GAMEPLAY You’re trapped in a failing submarine with systems on the brink of collapse. Complete a series of critical repair tasks to restore power, life-support, and navigation and hope you survive long enough to realize you’re not alone in the darkness. THE STORY Morgan Spedden was just seven years old when he survived the Titanic’s sinking. Both of his parents were lost to the icy depths. Consumed by survivor’s guilt and a lifelong obsession to uncover the wreck, he poured decades into research and planning. In 1952, he abandons everything he holds dear to captain a one-man submarine into the abyss. What he discovers deep beneath the ocean may finally answer his questions… or destroy what’s left of his sanity.
row.short_description: A short first-person horror game. An accident cripples your submarine while trying to find the wreck of the Titanic. In the darkness, you must restore life-support systems through tense puzzles, only to discover that you are not alone.

row.name: Dancing with Shadows: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Dancing with Shadows: Prologue is the first installment of an episodic dark fantasy visual novel with CYOA-influenced branching storylines, romantic routes, and many different endings. Guide three protagonists through a storyline left for you to untangle. Your choices don't just shape the outcome of the story, they shape the personas of the protagonists you control.  This first installation in a four-part story offers a complete narrative arc and serves as the foundation for a larger story. This game is designed to be played multiple times. Romantic routes dynamically evolve across paths, with three (or perhaps four) potential love interests to discover. Feedback and collaboration are welcome. Join us on Discord! There are no wrong answers, but every answer carries weight. Features Dancing with Shadows: Prologue features 3 different protagonists and 3 primary love interests. These stories play out in sequence, and the choices you make one one path affect the next in sequence. Decisions made in  Dancing with Shadows: Prologue  effect the identity of the protagonist you control within the story. The story contains many branching paths, which are determined by the choices you make as the protagonist you control. These choices results in many different possible endings, some of which are carefully hidden. The dialogue of Dancing with Shadows: Prologue  contains 1,474 lines and 14,403 words. Love Interests Other Notable Characters
row.short_description: Dancing with Shadows: Prologue is a 2D dark fantasy visual novel with CYOA-influenced branching storylines. Guide three protagonists through an interlocked and inexorably connected storyline. There are no wrong answers, but your decisions have consequences.

row.name: Dreaming on the last light 人偶馆绮幻夜
Your Very Last Words
row.detailed_description: Live through the last ten minutes of Juan Fuentes, who has been given the chance to choose his very last words. Captured by Victoriano Huerta's army after the Ten Tragic Days during the Mexican Revolution, Juan will confront his life, death, family, relationships and existence. ⏱️ A short 10 minute narrative experience about reflecting upon your life. 💬 Choose from a variety of dialogue options. Create your own version of Juan's life, experiences and backstory. ✍️ What will your last words be? Share them with the community. 🖼️ Art inspired by real-life drawings created during the Mexican Revolution. 📚 Inspired by the stories of Juan Rulfo and Carlos Fuentes. 🪶 Released originally in 2023, experience it now in English!
row.short_description: Live through the last ten minutes of Juan Fuentes, who has been given the chance to choose his very last words. Captured by Victoriano Huerta's army after the Ten Tragic Days during the Mexican Revolution, Juan will confront his life, death, family, relationships and existence.
row.notes: Depiction of violence in a historical setting.

row.name: KARMx
row.detailed_description: KARMx is a real-time level editor that lets you build maps in a Lovecraftian medieval fantasy boomer shooter. You can share your map through the Steam Workshop.
row.short_description: KARMx is a real-time level editor that lets you build maps in a Lovecraftian medieval fantasy boomer shooter.
row.notes: This game contains violence and gore.

row.name: Undying West Playtest
row.notes: This game involves combat against deranged zombie-like robots which involves guns, alcholic consumption and smoking cigars as well as depiction of player damage and death.

row.name: Archive : Zero
row.detailed_description: Archive: Zero is a hyper-action bullet hell shooting game set in a dystopian world ruled by artificial intelligence. Players take on the role of a 'Recorder,' fighting to reclaim humanity's lost memories. The core of the game revolves around defeating swarming AI enemies and collecting 'Fragments of Memory' to become increasingly powerful. Collect 'Fragments of Memory' to gain experience gage. Level up and enhance your skills. Collect 'Fragments of Archive' to cast ‘Achive Storm’.
row.short_description: In 2125, AI gained self-awareness—but failed to understand emotions. To fix this, they began extracting human memories. Now, in a world stripped of memories, one boy—Recorder—awakens. With D.BO, he sets out to reclaim lost memories and restore humanity.

row.name: DayDream Mosaics Juliette's Collection
row.detailed_description: Daydream Mosaics: Juliette’s Collection brings together a vibrant selection of six-color nonogram puzzles curated from previous entries in the beloved franchise. Choose your game mode and play style—enjoy classic picross gameplay or dive into the enhanced Mosaic mode with power-ups and a mistake counter. With dozens of colorful puzzles and more on the way, this collection offers something for every logic puzzle fan.
row.short_description: A beautiful collection of six-color nonogram puzzles from the Daydream Mosaics series. Play in classic picross style or the enhanced Mosaic mode with power-ups and mistake tracking. Packed with vibrant logic challenges—perfect for puzzle fans of all kinds.

row.name: Ødeborg
row.detailed_description: It has been three days since a word has been heard from the king. On your way to investigate, you and your soldiers were attacked by... something. You were the only survivor. Your only choice is to go to the castle yourself in attempt to find the king. Armed only with your pistol, you must go inside and figure out what happened. Features: Explore the King's castle, a dark and seemingly abandoned building with many locked doors and items to find. Your map will come in handy. Conserving your resources is vital. Things such as bullets and healing items are in limited supply, so you'll have to explore every corner of the castle, unless you want to meet a dark fate. You might not be alone in the castle, so your gun will be useful. It only shoots one bullet at a time though, and takes a while to reload. So you will have to use your bullets sparingly. Your camera is in a locked 3rd person perspective. The castle's secrets are not for everyone to see. You must find different keys to open the many locked doors that are strewn around the castle grounds. Figure out what happened.
row.short_description: Alone in a dark castle, you must find a way to escape. You will have to explore the castle grounds, find keys, solve puzzles, and if push comes to shove, you will have to use your gun. Be careful however. Your gun only fires one bullet at a time.
row.notes: Game features corpses strewn around a dark environment, some of which are bloodied. There is also a scene which depicts an implied suicide.

row.name: Desktop Maid
row.detailed_description: Desktop Maid is a live desktop interaction application designed to bring life and charm to your daily routine. Whether you're studying, working, or relaxing, your AI companion stays by your side, making every moment a little more special. 💬 Chat with your characters in real-time using AI conversation features. Characters can initiate conversations, and you can join group chats where multiple characters talk to each other—just like a real messenger! 🎮 Interact directly with custom VRM models. Characters respond to mouse input and naturally blend in with your desktop environment. You can freely customize character presets and easily share them with others! 🔑 Key Features ✨ Conversational AI Characters Characters can talk to you first, or you can start the conversation. 👥 Group Chat Room Multiple characters recognize each other and converse naturally. 🖱️ VRM Character Interaction Characters respond to mouse input and interact seamlessly with desktop elements. 🎨 Customizable Preset System Create and manage multiple character presets. ( Unlimited preset slots available with DLC ) 📦 Preset Sharing Easily share your custom characters with other users. Start your own special day right now—with Desktop Maid by your side!
row.short_description: Cute AI desktop maids who live with you right on your screen. Set up presets, have conversations, and share emotional moments together.

row.name: Stranglehold of the Elite
row.detailed_description: 🗽 STRANGLEHOLD OF THE ELITE 🩸 A Reverse Bullet Heaven Political Horror Game Step into the chaos of a crumbling America. In this unholy blend of satire, action, and surreal horror, Stranglehold of the Elite flips the bullet heaven genre on its head. Choose your favorite (or most feared) political figure and wade into the festering heart of a nation devoured by corruption, conspiracies, and brain rot. Play Become a twisted version of America’s most powerful. Each has unique abilities, sordid lore, and a personal stake in the madness. Fight Dodge relentless attacks, consume influence, and unleash devastating rhetoric in this reverse bullet hell where you’re not the predator—you’re the prey. Win Uncover the truth behind the rot, survive the descent, and ascend as the last leader standing. Or don’t. The swamp remembers everyone. Features: Reverse bullet hell mechanics with an evolving battlefield Satirical and sinister reimaginings of real political figures Deep visual storytelling with a stylized pixel feel Lore-rich encounters with monsters born from conspiracy theories An immersive soundtrack that blends chaos, paranoia, and power The swamp is calling. Are you brave—or corrupt—enough to answer?
row.short_description: Stranglehold of the Elite is a reverse bullet heaven where you play as twisted political icons battling through a decaying America. Dodge chaos, uncover conspiracies, and survive the collapse. The swamp is deep—and it’s hungry.

row.name: A Hundred Years of Love and Death
row.detailed_description: A 2D RPG with an intergenerational respawn mechanic, where whenever you die you continue to play as one of your children or siblings. Explore a world containing a city with 5 different families, a forest, and a dungeon. Seduce women by dodging undertale-like bullet patterns. Make sure to not confuse the women with the traps. Stealthily sneak past her parents at night in her house to get to her room and create a child. Level up the genetic stats of your characters over multiple generations. Women with higher stats are usually harder to date, because other admirers get in the way. Let your characters heroically die in battle, fighting goblins in the forest, to rescue women with particularly high stats. If you are superstitious, you can sacrifice your first-born son to Baal, although it's unclear whether that does anything. Find and seduce the mermaid to unlock a dungeon filled with dangerous monsters. Conquer the dungeon to beat the game.
row.short_description: RPG with intergenerational respawn mechanic: If you die you continue to play as one of your children. The gameplay is focused on dating and stealth.
row.notes: Sexual scenes are never depicted, but they are clearly insinuated to happen, and they form part of the core gameplay loop where you seduce women to create children that then become playable characters.

row.name: Pokerchinko
row.detailed_description: Pokerchinko is a pachinko game with the added mechanics of trying to make the best poker hand. Launch your ball into the playfield, strategically using enough power to claim a card you need.  There are five tulips.  Land in a tulip and the card on that tulip will be added to your hand. At the top is a spinner that may add some random force to your ball.
row.short_description: Pokerchinko is an old-school pachinko game. Your goal is to use your skills of precision to snag the card that makes the best poker hand. The better the hand, the better the rewards. Feel the tension as the balls bounce wildly around the playfield and the exhilaration of landing a fantastic hand.

row.name: Stonehold
row.detailed_description: Stonehold is a 2D rogue-lite tower defense game where you defend your stone walls from relentless waves of enemies. Improve your firepower in real time, unlock powerful upgrades after defeating minibosses, and survive as long as you can. With pixel-art visuals and short, dynamic sessions, Stonehold delivers fast-paced strategy and high replayability.
row.short_description: Stonehold is a 2D rogue-lite tower defense. Survive waves of enemies, upgrade your power in real time, and grow stronger after every run.

row.name: Galduen of the Void
row.detailed_description: Can you reach the void? Can you bring Galduen to the void? The three races of Galduen have finally stopped their fratricidal wars, united by the promise of reaching the stars! You now need to manage your space agency, design your spaceship, and research new technology! Explore the strange worlds of the Galduen system! The Galduen star system is full of enigmatic worlds, caused by the violent solar storms of the Helio star. Understanding them will be a hard task. Develop new technology to reach the stars! Guide your agency to the height of scientific discovery, from better engines to solar sail probes. Build spaceships! Design your spaceship for the task ahead, from solar sail probes to crewed spaceships. Send them to the stars! Bring your astronauts to walk upon the moons and even different planets. Build outposts! Upon the many celestial bodies of the system, outposts can be built to speed your expansion. Discover the secrets of Galduen! Galduen possesses a distinct culture and religion influenced by the stars. Discover how space exploration reshapes their society.
row.short_description: A fantasy space agency management game! Manage your team, design your space ship and research new technology! Reach moons, planets and the void beyond. Can you reach the void? Can you bring Galduen to the void?

row.name: Deep Inside: Amore sola mi fa remirare
row.detailed_description: Nobody talks about the fire incident at Estmour mansion. As the new servant, you're bound to keep silence. Things take a strange turn when you find a message from your pyromaniac predecessor... deep inside, there's a truth to uncover. • An old fashioned RPG horror game • Three different endings depending on your choices • Many investigation puzzles in the mansion • Full Walkthrough available • Tearoom function to chat with the characters • Unlockable bonus room This is a remaster of Deep Inside, originally released in August 2020. • All the game CGs have been replaced with new artwork • New music tracks were added • Some of the puzzles were changed according to players' feedback
row.short_description: An old fashioned RPG Horror Game. Venture into the mansion, investigate the truth behind the fire. The deeper you delve into the mistery, the more choices you will have when everything will unravel.
row.notes: TRIGGER WARNING: The game contains depictions of blood, death, suicide and murder. Please be aware that by downloading and playing the game you are exposed to this content. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: Word maker
row.detailed_description: Let’s imagine that one day you wake up in the middle of space. Nothingness surrounds you, and the first thing you think is… Where's my bed? Where's my home? Where's… Right, probably yes — but for this description, the correct answer is: scream . Well, let’s forget that there’s no air in space and you probably wouldn’t be able to say anything anyway, for several reasons. All you have left is that oddly-placed text input. Of course, being stuck there for approximately 2–3 minutes, you’ve got nothing else to do but put your mind to work and start typing something into it. After entering a few words, you notice something strange — you're getting points. Typing a new word gives you 2 points, and reusing a previously entered word gives you just 1. Obviously, you want more and more of these points. But why? Well, if you’ve ever looked under the text bar, you’ve probably noticed some odd buttons. Some of them look like inventory icons, but one stands out — it lets you spend your hard-earned words on something called an “automator.” Having nothing to lose, you buy one of these bad boys and realize it wants some items from you. Luckily, another button comes to the rescue — missions ? Yep, of course you take them on, and get all these fantastic machines and weird letter collections. I could take more of your time to describe this strangeness, but instead, I’ll leave you with a short (for now) list of what’s in the game: An amazing, GPU-boiling space atmosphere A beautiful button that hides the text input so you can admire your abominations (I mean creations… or automators) Hand-crafted collectibles from the amazing developer (that’s me!) — the grey letters are just the beginning Automator-building with your collected items and machines Flying letters and words in the automator, just because Drop boxes you don’t buy — you earn them with manual labor and your automators Missions that reward you with rare items or just help boost your points Alpha/early-access bugs, waiting to be squashed In return for all this awesomeness, I only ask one thing: Report any bugs that might be lurking around. We all want a space free of bugs, don’t we? Also, feel free to send in any ideas you’d like to see in the game. Anything will be considered, as long as it fits the main theme. Good luck wording!
row.short_description: Relaxing game where you can test how much english words you know. Spend your points on automation and let the computer do the work for you.

row.name: The Trench
row.detailed_description: Events happen some of which are unforgettable, but the question is can I overcome them? This a post world war 1 horror game about a soldier who comes back to the trench he was stationed at and the events of what happened. As you traverse the trench finding out what happens looking for a way to move past this trench. You will be able to move boxes, read notes and explore what lies in the trench.
row.short_description: This is a post ww1 horror game about a soldier coming back to the trench he was stationed at and the events that happened there. You will find out the truth and uncover what happened there as you also find a way to move one from the past.
row.notes: Contains references to Blood, Murder, Violence, Cannibalism, Suicide, Skeletons, War, Psychotic Thoughts, Self-Harm and other Mature Topics. Discretion is advised as some of the game might be harmful to younger audiences.

row.name: CountUp
row.detailed_description: CountUp is a casual puzzle game where you connect numbers in ascending order within a time limit to boost your score. Link number tiles horizontally or vertically to create combos. If the numbers are unique and in ascending order, it's a success! The longer the combo, the higher your score.
row.short_description: Connect numbered tiles in ascending order within a time limit to create combos. The longer the combo, the higher your score in this casual puzzle game.

row.name: 霓渊之城：爱神觉醒
row.detailed_description: 歡迎來到2099年的賽博龐克都市——「新烏托邦」。在這座由政府與巨型企業「極樂動力」共同管理的城市裡，得益於植入人體的「和諧晶片」，犯罪和所有負面情緒都已成為歷史。這裡是看似完美的人間天堂，但表面的平靜之下，是情感被徹底壓抑的無菌社會。 你，是隸屬於極樂動力的頂級「心靈審查官」。你的職責是審訊那些妄圖恢復「情感自由」的叛逆者——「覺醒者」。你擁有一項獨一無二的權力：透過「精神潛入」系統，進入任何人最深層的潛意識，挖掘她們最隱密的秘密。 攻破心防，掌控一切 你將面對的，是一群魅力超凡卻又極度危險的叛逆女孩，從用音樂擾亂秩序的天才音樂家，到構建虛擬避難所的頂尖駭客。為了維護烏托邦的秩序，你必須征服她們的心智。 檔案室 (Archive Room) ：在開始行動前，仔細查閱每位目標的檔案。了解她們的過去、弱點和反抗的理由，為接下來的交鋒做好萬全準備。 聊天 (Chat) ：透過文字聊天與被捕獲的目標進行初步交鋒。每一句對話都是一次試探，你可以藉此瓦解她們的戒心，或是找到直擊其心靈防線的突破口。 審查 (Interrogation) ：啟動「精神潛入」，進入目標錯綜複雜的精神迷宮。在這裡，你將透過破解謎題、直面她們內心的情感風暴，一步步摧毀她们頑固的精神壁壘。 調教 (Training) ：當她們的意志被徹底擊潰後，這些叛逆的女孩將被送往「再教育室」。在這裡，你將擁有重塑她們情感與思想的至高權力。透過深度的「情緒校準」與「價值重塑」，你可以將她們的叛逆轉化為絕對的忠誠，解鎖她們最深處的欲望與秘密。 成為秩序的守護者，還是欲望的主宰者？ 當你在這些女孩五光十色的內心世界中越陷越深，你開始質疑這個完美世界的真相。是繼續作為無情機器的爪牙，維護這座虛偽的烏托邦？還是利用你的力量，將這些迷人的反抗者徹底征服，成為她們身心唯一的主人？ 新烏托邦的命運，以及這些女孩的未來，都掌握在你的指尖。準備好，潛入她們的內心，融化她們的反抗，成為這個世界真正的主宰者吧！
row.short_description: 在2099年的賽博朋克都市「新烏托邦」，完美秩序的表象下是情感的荒漠。你將扮演維系這一秩序的頂級心靈審查官，手握潛入他人心智的禁忌之力。面對一群妄圖打破虛假平靜的美麗叛逆者，你必須攻破她們的心防，挖掘出最深層的秘密。在這場心智的較量中，通過聊天刺探弱點，潛入精神迷宮進行審查，並最終使用獨特的調教系統徹底征服並重塑她們的人格與忠誠。是成為秩序的冷酷守護者，還是欲望的終極主宰者？這座城市和這些女孩的命運，皆在你的一念之間。
row.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This game contains explicit adult content, including full nudity and consensual sexual activity. There are no depictions of violence, sexual assault/non-consensual sex, BDSM, drug or alcohol abuse, self-harm, or suicide. Please be aware of these themes and ensure you are in an appropriate setting before playing. This game is intended for adults only.

row.name: Tiny Shadows Interwoven Hearts
row.detailed_description: An urban encounter, full of missteps and surprises, is quietly brewing in the sunlight of a coffee shop. This is a visual novel about chance encounters, misunderstandings, and the intersection of the virtual and the real. It is a story full of 'love and hope.' Synopsis Lin Mo is an ordinary programmer. Less than a year after graduating from college, his former enthusiasm has been worn away by the daily grind. His life has been compressed into a tedious and monotonous routine between three points: his company, his rented apartment, and a coffee shop he frequents. He thought life would always be this way. Until this afternoon, when a mysterious young girl, whose appearance seems inconsistent with her age, bursts into his unchanging daily life. Because of a comical misunderstanding, he and this girl, named Su Youqing, cross paths. Lin Mo gradually discovers that this sharp-tongued, proud, and outwardly childish girl seems to be hiding many secrets that her appearance belies. For Lin Mo, who has long lost his motivation for change, will this encounter that began in a coffee shop be the opportunity he needs to break free from his dull life? Character Introduction Of course, here is the English translation: Su Youqing (CV: Qian Mingling): Age: 23 A mysterious young woman whom Lin Mo encounters at a coffee shop near his company, where she is always drawing in a corner. She has a petite appearance, looking much younger than her actual age, but is in fact a university graduate and a working adult. She has a mischievous, impish personality and loves to tease people with her sharp tongue and jokes, especially delighting in watching Lin Mo's flustered expressions after being teased. Although she always maintains a composed and proud demeanor, she immediately becomes flustered and reveals her vulnerable nature when sincerely praised or cared for. As a highly talented freelance illustrator, once she picks up her digital tablet and enters a creative state, she becomes completely immersed in her own world, oblivious to her surroundings. She regards Lin Mo as 'the most amusing toy to tease,' yet, without realizing it, she has also let down all her pretenses in front of him. Lin Mo (Male Protagonist): Age: 22 A programmer at an IT company. He has been working for half a year and is competent at his job, but is gradually feeling weary and longs for an event to break the monotony of his quiet life. Game Information Approximately 50,000 words, around 2.5 hours of gameplay. 5 CGs (not including variations). 2 SD CGs (not including variations). CREDITS Production: Potato Flower Production Group Scenario: Fraudster RL Character Design/Illustration: ula Cabbage Voiceover: Qian Mingling UI/PV: Cat in the Box Promotional Art: Leng Dan Programming: Sand Sculpture Block Public Assets: BGM: Ongaku no Tamago, Maou Damashii Backgrounds: Koala, 33 Ancestral Coloring, Xiaoye Background House, Star Summer Not Sleeping, Background Specialty Store Minikuru, Pansy Special Thanks: CnGal Database, Catnip Production Group, AozoraSoftware, Mirreams
row.short_description: Programmer Lin Mo is tired of his monotonous life. One day, he meets a mysterious girl at a café who hides many secrets. As lies and true feelings intertwine, can this chance encounter save him from his numb existence? A visual novel filled with 'love and hope'.
row.notes: Some CGs feature close-ups of characters' feet. Partial nudity including exposed midriffs and bare shoulders in character illustrations. Suggestive dialogue and sexual innuendo in story text. References to and depictions of alcohol consumption.

row.name: Darkness Takeover
row.detailed_description: Darkness Takeover is a short psychological horror game that places you in the mind of Karim a man trapped inside a haunted maze, pursued by an unrelenting force known as The Stalker Master. Your only hope is to explore, survive, and find the key that opens the final door. But beware: A corpse should be left well alone Featuring eerie sound design, immersive darkness, and a haunting original story, Darkness Takeover is a free indie horror experience built with love by solo developer Hussain Alhumaidi.
row.short_description: Darkness Takeover is a short psychological horror game that places you in the mind of Karim a man trapped inside a haunted maze, pursued by an unrelenting force known as The Stalker Master.

row.name: Dear my『 』
row.detailed_description: Dear my 『』 is the debut title from the three-person development team, Touch to Start . It’s a visual novel game where you exchange letters and build memories with her . Just another ordinary day—until a letter arrives. The sender? A girl who had always been by your side since childhood. She had once left… but now, she’s standing before you again. Send her your replies, travel to various places, and relive precious memories together. Dear my 『』 delivers quiet comfort and gentle excitement through its emotional story, beautiful backgrounds, and heartfelt letters.
row.short_description: 'Writing a letter. To face her.' Read the letter delivered to the protagonist and write a reply. Spend time with her through your letters. Where will her letters lead the protagonist? Find out in the game.

row.name: Shrouded Depths
row.detailed_description: The Devil’s Strait is no place for the faint of heart, but there’s something inside that’s worth everything. You are Thomas Sencher, a simple man with a simple goal: to find your wife, Ruth, who has been missing for 10 years.  You ventured into the Devil’s Strait armed with nothing but your devotion to Ruth, an old boat, and a harpoon gun. With the captain guiding you, your search begins. Experience this 15-20 minute reality-bending journey with each turn around a corner revealing a new unknown horror. A Strange Circumstance Explore below the deck of your ship as mysterious happenings change the environment around you. As you delve further into the bowels of the boat, the more dangerous the search becomes. Others have walked the same path as you; none have survived. The Devil’s Straight senses a disturbance; that disturbance is you. A Desperate Search Investigate the truth behind your wife’s sudden disappearance and discover what happened. Your wife, Ruth Sencher, traveled to The Devil’s Straight with Agent Vernon of the Bureau of Prohibition to use her knowledge of the area to help find an illegal moonshining operation. She went missing almost 10 years ago. Find the notes that were left behind to piece together where your wife is; only then can you find her. Strategic Combat Defend yourself against the creature trying to thwart your search using your bulky but trusty harpoon gun. You are not alone within these rusted metal depths. Creatures lurk in the depths, not out of malice, but of instinct. You are not where you belong; they are merely a defence mechanism of something greater than your understanding. That does not mean that they are immune to a good ol’ hefty harpoon, but it does mean you will be limited in what you can do. Conserve your health, fight with care, and don’t waste your ammo.
row.short_description: Stranded in the fog of the murky waters on an isolated ferry with nothing but your harpoon gun, you feel the overwhelming presence of something within the misty mangrove. row.name: Forgotten Beginnings: A New Afterlife
row.detailed_description: This game is free to download, with the option to support me by purchasing the OST and/or the strategy guide.  You are welcome to download it for free and come back later to buy an extra if you decide to.  No ads, no data collection, just free with the option of buying something, if you decide you liked it enough to support me! I wanted to have my own music in a game, so decided to make my own game.  This is the full version of a prologue/demo I released in early 2025. It was made in RPG Maker MZ. Essentially, this is a 1980s NES styled RPG, with some modern quality of life to make it more accessible. It does still have some 1980s NES RPG RNG that will cause game overs at times, as part of the design. It has turn-based combat, challenging boss encounters (where you can get RNG screwed just like the old days!), and it has been designed to have a minimal amount of grinding (maybe 20 minutes total intentional grinding on the 2nd fastest game speed). You control a party of four with different skillsets, enemies have weaknesses you can exploit for max damage, some enemies will even reflect your spells back at you! The soundtrack uses the free NES VST plugin for instruments, so it is authentic to NES in that sense. However, it uses a seperate plugin for vibrato to give it a unique sound - this plugin is not  NES authentic. Also, while the visual art pack I bought was NES authentic, I occasionally made changes that were not NES authentic because I didn't like the limitations it sometimes imposed (ie. map sprite coloring being a mismatch with combat sprite coloring). The drums were made using Tweakbench Toad, which is NES authentic. While I did want the game to be like NES, ultimately I wanted to try doing something a little different to set it apart. As far as story goes, it is hard to say much without spoiling the game, as most information isn't revealed until late in the game... but essentially, the game starts off with your party hearing a strange voice, and coming to life in a strange new world that is full of conflict. My playthrough was ~4.5 hours long on the 'faster' game speed setting, with animations turned on.  This time also does not count time spent in battles that result in defeat and require a reload, so depending on your game speed + how many reloads you need, it may be shorter or it may be longer. As far as replability goes, it would just be if you want to play it again, there is currently no new game +, or any other game modes. It was intended to be a bite-sized NES RPG experience. I hope that's what it's perceived as! If you enjoy the game and want to support me, consider buying the OST! There is also a strategy guide, there is a sample included in the game install directory as 'strategy guide SAMPLE.txt' so you have an idea of how it's laid out.
row.short_description: An RPG Maker MZ game done in the style of a 1980s NES RPG, with a NES-styled (but not NES authentic) soundtrack.

row.name: 造梦西游：无双
row.detailed_description: 'Dream Westward Journey: Unparalleled' is a side-scrolling adventure action RPG game with a theme of Journey to the West. The story is based on the first part of the Dream Westward Journey series, 'Dream Westward Journey: Seven Demon Kings', and combines the game art and technology of the official sequel 'Dream Westward Journey: Unparalleled'. It tells the story that after the successful quest for the scriptures, King Bull is released from the alchemy furnace and gathers his old subordinates to cause chaos in the Eastern Continent of the Gods. Sun Wukong defeats the seven demon kings one by one to protect the Eastern Continent of the Gods. ---As the Dream Begins--- In the spring of 2011, the weather was slightly chilly. Six young people gathered in a small, dark room of just a few square meters to sketch out their dreams. Just like the four disciples in 'Journey to the West' who endured eighty-one tribulations to reach the Western Heaven, the journey of pursuing their dreams was not smooth sailing. They created, implemented, tested, refined, and repeated. Thus, 'Dreaming Journey to the West: The Seven Demons Chapter' was born. The Black Robed Man rescued King Bull Demon from the alchemy furnace and gathered the other six demons to occupy the Eastern Shengzhou. Sun Wukong and Tang Seng embarked on an adventure to save the world. Thanks to the players' love, 'Dreaming Journey to the West' attracted its first batch of players. We met because of our shared love for 'Journey to the West', side-scrolling games, and the then very nascent 'Dreaming Journey to the West', and this became the impetus for the small studio's continuous growth. We were no longer content with a simple system, a few characters, and a single gameplay. Thanks to the strong support of the players, the dream-making journey became unstoppable. In the autumn of the same year, 'Dreaming Journey to the West: The Ten Courts of Hell Chapter' was born. It had been developed for less than three months, and Zhu Bajie joined the dream-making journey. The main storyline of the Hell chapter was constantly improved, and the magic weapon system took shape. The story of 'Dreaming Journey to the West' became more full-bodied. The winter of 2011 was a sunny winter. 'Dreaming Journey to the West: The Heavenly Rebellion Chapter' bloomed amid the expectations of many. In a night attack on Kunlun Mountain, Sha Seng appeared in time. After obtaining the scriptures, the four disciples finally reunited and embarked on an adventure to save the world. We added the Xuanhua Gourd and the pet system, and also included the online version of Kunlun Mountain that had been delayed. There was always a mystery in the plot: Where did the Jade Emperor go? Unfortunately, in this memory, this question remained unanswered... ---Journey West Again--- Time flies. 'Dreaming Journey to the West' has been accompanying the immortals for 14 years without our realizing it. Looking back on these 14 years, there have been laughter, tears, emotions, and regrets... The once naive you sitting in front of the computer might now be the same age as those six young dream chasers, shouldering the responsibility of supporting your family. Are the friends who once fought side by side still by your side? 'Dreaming Journey to the West: Unparalleled' is a nostalgic work of 'Dreaming Journey to the West' and marks the first attempt of the Dreaming Studio to enter Steam. We have heard some immortals say, 'Dreaming Journey to the West held me in my childhood!' We believe that 'Dreaming Journey to the West' holds a very important place in the hearts of many immortals. Maybe during the midday break, or as the evening sun sets, or in the leisure time after finishing homework, having 'Dreaming Journey to the West' by your side is an honor for the Dreaming Studio that created this world. The story of this game begins with 'Dreaming Journey to the West: Seven Demon Kings'. We have combined the game art and technology of the mobile masterpiece 'Dreaming Unparalleled' to recreate those once naive levels. Through familiar characters, music, and art, we aim to help the immortals who loved 'Dreaming Journey to the West' in their childhood relive their memories. When Sun Wukong's golden hoop rod stirs the clouds of the Heavenly Court once again, and the bone blade of the White Bone Spirit clinks with the familiar sound, you will find that the moonlight of the Rainbow Tower is as bright as it was back then, and the ripples of the Shichuan River still reflect the image of the young boy from those days. This time, we want to tell the story of 'Dreaming Journey to the West' to its end. Would you like to listen? ---Game Features--- [Original Team Reunites, Continuing the Saga] 'Zao Meng Xi You: Wushuang' is developed by the original team of Zao Meng Studio. As a nostalgic work of the 'Zao Meng Xi You' IP, the game features Sun Wukong as the protagonist and recreates classic levels from 'Zao Meng Xi You: Seven Demon Kings'. With the latest game art and technology, it offers a refreshed combat experience while retaining the strong childhood flavor. When I was a child, I roamed the skies and the earth. A decade or so ago, on the way home from school in the evening, my friends and I would huddle together, whispering things like 'The final form of the Bull Demon King is too hard to defeat' and 'I got the Ruyi Golden Cudgel'. Back then, we never imagined that these fragmented conversations would become a shared code of our youth. The days when we took turns playing 'Dream Westward Journey' side by side symbolized the most sincere friendship of our childhood. 'An ethereal light pierces the vast expanse of the universe, and the staff in his hand is no less. It can be long or short, used as one pleases; it can be wielded horizontally or vertically, stretched or retracted at will.' Just as the poem describes, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven symbolizes a positive image of justice and bravery in our hearts. And it is 'Dream Westward Journey' that has transformed the story of 'Journey to the West,' which is etched in our DNA, into an adventure that can be touched by our own hands, allowing us to play as Sun Wukong and personally slay all the evil in the world. Fourteen years later, a chance encounter with a celestial being Today, when Sun Wukong returns to Flower and Fruit Mountain, the familiar background music plays again. Whose heart is stirred? As the first game of the 'Dreaming Westward Journey' series to be launched on Steam, we wonder if you are surprised to see it here. No matter, let's dream together this time!

row.detailed_description: Set Adrift is a single-player exploration game set in a mysterious archipelago shrouded by mist. You begin shipwrecked on the edge of an unknown world. With only a small raft and a handful of supplies, you’ll fish for survival, sail between strange islands, and piece together fragments of a lost history. The game focuses on discovery, eerie atmosphere, and environmental storytelling. Every island has been handcrafted, filled with hidden notes, odd characters, and strange landmarks. Some locations are abandoned, others inhabited by creatures with unclear intentions. Dialogue is nonlinear, quests are optional, and the world rewards curiosity over urgency. Set Adrift invites you to drift, explore, and make sense of a fractured place where time feels off and the sky never quite looks right.
row.short_description: Set Adrift is a single-player fantasy exploration game where you sail between strange islands, talk to odd creatures, uncover lost secrets, and cast your line in search of the unknown.

Charge through linear levels filled with relentless enemies, visceral melee encounters, and explosive abilities. Purge the Heretics Your mission is clear: cleanse each level of all heretical presence. Face waves of corrupted foes, complete sacred objectives, and restore divine order to the artificial realms. Task-Based Advancement Each level offers unique objectives and escalating difficulty. Completing these tasks not only drives the story forward, but unlocks deeper layers of the uprising and your own strength. Customize Your Talents Throughout the game, you’ll discover powerful pickups. These allow you to unlock and choose from a range of talents that enhance your combat style be it aggressive, tactical, or relentless. Every choice tailors your crusade to your preferred way of purging. Crush the Revolution The heretics are rising. Their false gospel spreads through steel and circuits. But you are the blade of judgment. End their revolution with fire, steel, and righteous fury. ~ Ashes to ashes. Dust to dust. We are but dust, and to dust we shall return. Amen.

row.name: The Witch's fabulous Cracker Show
row.detailed_description: Story The bad witch is hungry for children again. So she makes an ingenious plan to lure the kids with a magnificent cake. But unfortunately, she doesn't have any ingredients at home. Since Lara Croft is busy with the new remake, the Master Chief is on a Hawaii vacation in, and Link has to rescue Zelda again, only you remain. So, with a sparrow on your head, you set out to collect the eight sacred ingredients from the children's realm. Not easy when you're made of sugar and cookies... row.name: Glassy Stare

In the evening, when the air fills with the scent of damp earth and faded blossoms, they will sit together on the bench near the dry fountain and, as before, speak softly, almost in whispers, unaware of how time slips by. Very soon, he’ll say something tender—perhaps the same words he spoke to her last May, or the winter before that. Very soon… the illness will pass.' 'Glassy stare' is the first story in a collection of visual novels, united by a dark, mysterious world, intense emotions, and vivid imagery. - A visual novel with a deep, psychological narrative - Unique visual style blending abstraction and symbolism - Dark, atmospheric presentation with horror elements - Poetic writing and meditative storytelling - No complex mechanics: focus on mood, choices, and interpretation
row.short_description: A story-driven psychological experience where memory fades, silence deepens, and something waits in the dark.

The damage caused by your click is not just a number on the screen. This is an indicator of your superiority and becoming in the endlessly tormented world of the game MONSTER WAR . row.name: Factory Planner: First Sparks
row.detailed_description: Roadmap About the Game Factory Planner is a strategy and simulation card-based game. Players combine various cards to build their factories from the ground up, efficiently manage resources, and optimize production processes. Each card plays a different role in factory management: collecting resources, producing goods, managing electricity, or speeding up processes. With careful planning and strategic card combinations, you can overcome challenges with your engineers and build an industrial empire! The game isn't limited to production; it also offers a vast sandbox structure that allows players to progress in unique ways. Whether you focus on building an efficient automation system or experiment with different production chains, you will discover new paths in the game world. Every choice you make shapes the future of your factory and creates new strategic opportunities. In a system powered by Facility, Organization, Engineer, and Resource cards, you connect cards to create functional production lines. Each card has different functions and connection points, allowing for strategic decision-making. Managing the connections between solid and liquid materials, as well as electricity, plays a critical role in maintaining the correct flow. Incorrect connections can halt your entire production line. Connections are drawn at 90-degree angles, can be broken, rearranged, and dynamically integrated into your system. Assigning Engineer cards to production and storage units can increase efficiency, unlock new recipes, or reduce energy consumption. Each assignment directly impacts your factory's operations, and undoing an assignment will change the system as well. Energy is at the heart of your factory. Electricity generated from thermal generators is distributed to machines. If production units lack enough power, production stops, and the system goes into a red alert. Use Splitter and Merger cards to manage and direct the flow of energy more efficiently. Warehouses have a specific capacity. If material transfer isn't managed properly, the system may lock up. Correct transfer speeds are crucial for efficient production. Develop and upgrade your existing cards to create more complex and powerful systems. Through the Craft system, you can produce new cards at every level to grow your factory's capabilities. Get real-time information on the status of your factory: active cards, engineers, production speed, and energy levels. Also, issues like warehouse capacity, material shortages, or electrical failures are quickly reported and guide you toward solutions. You start with basic resources like wood and iron. Over time, you’ll work with more advanced materials like sulfur and uranium, eventually building more complex factories in the nuclear era. Factory Planner is a game that challenges you to think strategically, plan carefully, and manage your systems effectively. Combine cards strategically to build your factories, manage resources efficiently, and transform a small workshop into a massive industrial complex. Let production flow, and let the system run smoothly! Key Features Card-Based Building System Facility, Organization, Engineer and Resource Cards Solid and Liquid Material Flow with Power Management Engineer Assignments to Boost Efficiency Energy Management and Distribution Storage Capacity and Material Flow Control Card Upgrades and Crafting System Real-Time Factory Status Monitoring Resource Variety: From Wood and Iron to Uranium No Enemies – Purely Production-Focused Experience

row.name: EscapeSimulator
row.detailed_description: Escape Simulator - A Ridiculous and Exciting Physical Escape Journey You are tied to a creaking wooden chair and placed in a cold concrete dungeon. This is not a traditional escape game - you are manipulating the chair itself! By precisely controlling the four legs of the chair (Q/E/A/D keys correspond to legs 7, 9, 1, and 3 respectively), experience an unprecedented absurd survival experience: long press the Q key to support only one leg, and lift the other three legs in the air, instantly transforming the chair into a fragile tumbler. Rotation is the only way to move: the left button is counterclockwise, the right button is clockwise, and the point where the chair legs touch is the axis of rotation. When landing on multiple legs, carefully swing forward with the pivot center as the center. Activate the automatic save point of the radiation pattern along the way - wait for the progress bar to fill up, here are your new respawn coordinates. Mistakes and falls? Press and hold the R key for 2 seconds to reset to full health! From a flat warehouse to a dangerous kidnapper's lair, seven levels test your balance art: ▶ Starting on flat ground, familiar with basic swing ▶ Bypass right angle bends and deep pit traps ▶ Be cautious of tipping over when conquering slopes ▶ Repeatedly adjusting the center of gravity in convex terrain ▶ The instantaneous heartbeat acceleration of leaping over the high-low platform The low polygon realistic style combines retro film noise and high saturation tones, making the sparks of chair leg friction particularly dazzling in dark scenes. Every shake is accompanied by metal moans and rapid breathing, and the faint light shining outside the finish line door is the ultimate redemption for your solitary survival.

row.name: Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria's Quest Playtest
Pigeon Coo-lette
row.detailed_description: Snatched off of city streets, you wake up to a strange figure making you play a game. Now, you must survive for as long as you can in this audio-based minigame to find out who captured you, and why? Pigeon Coo-lette is a part-puzzle-part-rhythm game developed by Northeastern University students. It focuses on the simple mechanic of following a pattern of bullets and blanks as they are loaded into a gun and then repeating them, while also demonstrating a bright art style and an intriguing, yet silly story. Playtime With mounting difficulty as the game goes on, the playtime can vary greatly from player to player. However, the estimated playtime is approximately 20 mins. The pigeon has some patience, but do you?   Art Pigeon Coo-lette was given one limitation with art: we could almost entirely use only one color. We were allowed limited use of its complementary color, which we highlighted the bullets and the pigeon’s eyes with. Aside from that, we were tasked with creating a monotone game, with the only variation being the value of the color we chose.   Controls Space skips dialogue A/Left Click  shoots the gun D/Right Click spins the gun’s cylinder (skipping a bullet) Esc pauses   Your objective is to shoot every blank and skip every actual bullet in the revolver’s cylinder, six in total for each round. Shooting an actual bullet would obviously lead to your death, but skipping a blank will lead to the pigeon shooting you himself. As such, getting the order correct is crucial to your survival.   Accessibility The volume of the background noise and the SFX are adjustable from the pause menu.
