row.detailed_description: Defend Your Base   You are the last bastion.  Stand strong against monsters and ghouls as they carry out a full-out attack to destroy your base. Survive long enough to acquire candies, obtain powerups, and protect your base from destruction.   Two Ways To Play   Campaign Mode: Fight your way through 9 unique campaign levels, each with their own twists and challenges to conquer.  Do you have what it takes to break the curse once and for all. Survival Mode: Fight endlessly against monsters and ghouls while obtaining new powerups and curses every few rounds. How long will you hold out for before the monsters overtake your base? Wield the power of the elements Give yourself an edge in battle by harnessing the power of the elements to your advantage. Magic-imbued crystals can be unlocked to powerup your saw during combat, letting you slice through the incoming monsters with ease. If you see a crystal appear, destroy it with your saw and watch the magic unfold. Try stacking multiple elements on top of each other to create devastating combinations!    Earn Rewards & Customize   As you earn achievements in Sawmania, you will be rewarded with a bonus currency that you may redeem in the Trades & Offers store in exchange for miscellaneous cosmetic items. These allow you to customize your gameplay experience by equipping any combination of launchers, saw skins, and particle trails. The choice is yours!
row.short_description: Protect your base against an onslaught of monsters using your mighty saw!

row.name: Spencer's Spaghetti Quest
row.detailed_description: Spencer's Spaghetti Quest is a fast-paced 3D platforming puzzle-solving shooter, made up entirely of hand drawn sprites. There are various little things around the map you can collect that will make you a bit stronger, and a bunch of fun movement mechanics to mess around with. Shoot magic bolts from your fingers, stretch out your arm and punch enemies far away, or use it to launch yourself and reach hard to get areas. There will be a variety of puzzles, NPC's to interact with, plenty of enemies, and tons of random wacky antics! Many of the character's you'll see were made and submitted by community members! You can get different costumes by playing the game, some which will be exclusive to early access players and discord members! Featured Content Creators BunBuns :
row.short_description: Run, jump and punch your way through a bright hand-drawn world collecting upgrades and currency to become even stronger! Progress through different themed levels and defeat unique bosses to gather the legendary spaghetti ingredients!

row.name: The Calamity Trials
row.detailed_description: THE SCREEN The screen will have everything you need to begin the trials. You will enter your mind in a world we create. You will feel and experience everything as if you're truly there. We won't be checking in too often since there are plenty of other subjects, but I can assure you that trying to leave the chair by force won't work. Little tip: don't stare at the screen too long since you'll be here awhile, for your sanity. THE TRIALS It's too late to turn back; you signed the papers, remember? The trials are what you chose over the death sentence. You'll be tasked to complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles. Reach the end goal before IT catches up to you. These weapons will either help you increase speed and further the gap from IT , or become another obstacle you must overcome. Being caught by IT or falling into the void will result in FAILURE . The only way to win is by reaching the LIGHT at the very end of the stage. I can't provide too much information on what we're preparing for until you complete the trials, but I will say you are not ready for what's to come. THE KHRON Khrons is a currency that allows you to unlock stages when you have the required amount. You receive 1000 khrons every stage completed. If you FAIL a stage, you will lose 100 khrons. This provides you 10 opportunities to complete a stage. THE DOOR Stages are still a work in progress, but we have plenty of time. Until we feel you are ready or have the required amount of khrons, the door remains CLOSED!
row.short_description: Complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles while IT chases you. These weapons will increase speed, or become another obstacle you must overcome.

row.name: Body & Soul
row.detailed_description: In this puzzle game, you take control of various characters. Figuring out your path to the goal tile. God's ray helps you stay alive, but when an obstruction breaks the sight, you die and become a ghost. As long as you are in god's sight, you can possess any body. Find your path to the goal. It's our first game, just made for fun and given away for free. Enjoy!
row.short_description: A 3D puzzle game. Possess different bodies to find the path to the Goal tile.

row.name: Wordcaster
row.detailed_description: Overview Your voice is your weapon. Wordcaster is a voice-driven RPG adventure where you step into the robes of a wizard, casting spells by speaking words aloud. Real-time speech recognition listens to your voice and unleashes magic against enemies. Gameplay In Wordcaster, every spell comes from your voice. Choose from a variety of spellbooks, each with its own set of words and power multipliers. Face waves of enemies across multiple worlds, take down challenging bosses, and collect coins to upgrade your wizard. Progression is built around classic RPG elements: Spellbooks with unique vocabularies and damage multipliers Levels & XP to grow stronger and unlock new abilities Coins & Shops to purchase upgrades and customize your wizard Whether you’re mastering basic words or commanding advanced spellbooks, every victory comes from how clearly and quickly you can cast your spells.
row.short_description: Wordcaster is a voice-driven RPG adventure where you become a wizard, casting spells by speaking words aloud. Real-time speech recognition turns your voice into magical attacks against enemies. Unlock spellbooks, battle bosses, collect coins, and level up in a unique voice-powered RPG experience.

row.name: a Difficult game about Wheelchair Playtest
T.B.M ~The Blueppers Mayhem~
row.detailed_description: *So you want a 1v1 experience? A combination of a platformer and a fighting game? Well you are in the right place! Welcome to The Blueppers Mayhem where we don't take things to seriosly... after all, you are in the Void City the place where all the clishes and the mistakes live in, under the tree of the Multi-Multiverse, where all the Brands you know live in separate universes... *Now about gameplay. So as you have read it is a 1v1 fighting game and the maps are bigger for more freedom in movement. The goal of the gamemode 'Game Robbery' is to get a kill. After that a game will spawn around the map and you will need to colect it. As soon as you are carring the game try to get to your basket and stand near it for 4 seconds to score a point. First player which gets 3 games wins. *The progresion is split in two parts: *Juicy zaps - reward only available by end of the match or by promotions which result from playing matches. These are used for upgrading your characters to unlock slots, to buy clisher packs, to buy Rare Prints and to buy Overcharges. *Dimes - reward from promotions as said before, but also through real money. With these you can do everything said up with two diffrences. You can not upgrade your chracters with juicy zaps so you have no slots for Upgrades and also you can buy with dimes only, Tags which are a cosmetic to express your emotions. *So, in the end, in order to level up your chracters you need juciy zaps even if you spend money but they are unbuyable through real money. So here is the first ever implemetension of a P2W WALL which is nor Pay to win it is actually Play to Win! In exchange dimes have really good values if you want to get some through your beloved cradit card... *There is not a really complex story yet, though I have a question for you. How did Blueppers break his display? And how did Scarrlet get her scar? Well... nobody knows, yet... *There are some goals in this game: 1. Promote all your characters! -by winning games from matches with each clisher; 2.Get all Tags! -each has a unique way of unlocking them get in the game and you will see! 3.Upgrade your clishers and get all the Upgrades (Rare Prints and Overcharges). The jurney will be hard and you will rage but after a while you will become the master of.... T.B.M. ~THE BLUEPPERS MAYHEM!~
row.short_description: The best f2p play there is! Play against a friend or in a public match in fast paced 1v1 battles. Win matches to get resorces for progresion and unlock as many clishers as you can so you can promote as many of them for great rewards. The more support this product gets the more updates it will get!!!

row.name: OverField
row.detailed_description: Worldview Rota Tech is recruiting new members! You'll become the new Leader of the exploration team through tests! In this world lies a hidden realm known as the “OverField”—a mysterious frontier at the very heart of Rota’s research. You'll encounter various events with explorers, face challenges from mysterious forces, and uncover the truth behind the “OverField”.   ▼Game Features ◆Fantastical 'Field' Within 'Reality'◆ Step into a meticulously crafted miniature-style 3D world—both whimsical and lifelike. With stunning visuals that feel like a living animated film, every step brings the world vividly to life.   ◆Exploration Filled With Fun and Danger◆ Enjoy adventure-filled box garden exploration with surprises at every turn. Experience lighthearted and charming combat while leading your team through thick and thin.   ◆Meet Charismatic Exploration Members◆ Form your own exploration squad, travel between 'Reality' and 'Field', and build trust with your teammates through adventures.   ◆Create Dream Homes and Customize Styles◆ Personalize explorers' outfits with multi-part dyeing and fashion combinations. Build your plaza home with creative ideas using multiple furniture themes.   ◆Enjoy Daily Life Beyond Adventures◆ Seaside tranquility, forest swings... Perfect spots for solitude to heal life's fatigue. For socializing, join barbecue parties, dynamic soccer games, and COSPLAY contests! Meet the life and friends you've been longing for at Rota Plaza - always a place to enjoy the world's beauty!
row.short_description: Tiny Miniature World Cozy Light Social Grand Open Adventure Hello! Let's explore the OverField together!

row.name: Eldritch Archives
row.detailed_description: Working as a paranormal investigator means you have never had a shortage of strange clientele. But this letter and the page accompanying it have begun to erode your sanity and you have been possessed with a desperate need to investigate its origin. Eldritch Archives is a short horror game where you take the role of an investigator that has answered the call of a concerned client. You arrive at their home and must attempt to ward against the forces that inhabit it. Use your environment You can interact with, pick up and throw a variety of items and use them to help you ward against the evil forces. Detect supernatural energy You have a trusty detector that will help you find and deal with objects that emit dark energies. Collect information and solve the mystery There are mystical pages in hidden places that will unravel the true nature of the events that unfold. Collecting them all may lead you to discover something of real supernatural significance. Your actions will determine your journey During your investigations there are a number of stories to tell... some have more grisly fates than others. Good luck.
row.short_description: Nightmares of awful creatures and twisted worlds have haunted you since you received a letter from a prospective client. Delving into the mystery behind this cursed page may be the only chance you have of ever sleeping again. Nobody ever said being a paranormal investigator was easy...
row.notes: The game contains blood but is not realistic due to the nature of the art style.

row.name: Katana
row.detailed_description: Katana — The Ultimate Clicker Game for Sword Enthusiasts Click. Collect. Repeat. In Katana , every click brings you closer to building the greatest katana collection ever. Get a random katana every 3 hours and watch your collection grow with unique blades forged through community creativity. 3-Hour Drop Rates* : Common – 80% Uncommon – 16% Rare – 3% Epic – 0.99% Legendary – 0.01% * Drop rates are subject to change Key Features : A katana. Obviously. Items to boost and expand your collection Unlockable achievements A community fully powered by katana passion Submit your own designs via Discord! Every katana in the game is inspired or created by players like you. Join the fun, leave your mark, and shape the future of Katana !
row.short_description: Katana is a clicker game where you click... a katana! Click the katana to earn more katanas — simple, addictive, and ever-growing. Every 3 hours, you’ll receive a random katana drop to add to your collection.

row.name: Island Market Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Roadmap About the Game ◆ Increase your reputation by decorating your home with 100 different items . Express your style with paintings, furniture, and decorative accessories. Market and home decorations directly affect your in-game prestige system! ◆ Diversify your income by offering 73 different products for sale. Showcase various product categories to expand your customer base. Reach maximum profit potential through strategic product placement! ◆ Discover the dynamics of the game with countless weather events brought by 4 different seasons . Effects like snow, rain, and scorching heat can impact everything from farming to trade. Each season brings new challenges and opportunities, adding life to the game! ◆ Diversify your farming by growing 47 different crops . Optimize the processes of sowing, watering, and harvesting to achieve maximum yield. Sell your produce at markets or use it in various recipes! ◆ Make your game even more colorful with events that appear on specific dates. These seasonal or special-day events offer rare rewards and surprise opportunities. Stay active to never miss out and benefit from every advantage! ◆ Raise 3 different types of animals to obtain various products like milk, wool, eggs, and meat. Take care of their health and happiness to increase productivity. Sell the products you collect or use them in your own production processes! ◆ Shape your in-game relationships by completing quests from the kingdom, pirates, and townsfolk . Each quest has its own story and reward. Through these missions, you can discover new areas and witness different storylines! ◆ Grab your hammer and head to the workshop! Use 10 different machines to craft 40 unique products! From cheese to fabric, jam to alcohol everything depends on your craftsmanship. You choose what to produce and shape the economy your way!
row.short_description: Island Market Simulator – In this strategy and economy simulation game set in an island town, build your trade empire by starting with a small market. Produce your goods through farming, livestock, and supply chain management, and expand your business with seasonal dynamics and festivals!

row.name: Slash
row.detailed_description: A skill based game with lots of customizability, where you slash bullets with a sword before they hit the ground, to earn money and get new cosmetics. When the play button is pressed bullets will fall down from the top of the screen, you must hit them with your sword before they hit the ground or you will die and have to start over. There are three different spots the bullets can spawn at, each one corresponds with a certain attack. If the bullet spawns on the left you must hit it with a left slash. If it spawns on the right you must hit it with a right slash. If it spawns in the middle you must hit it with a stab. Each bullet you strike you will get a point and cash. You can buy cosmetics with cash. The more points you have the more often bullets will spawn, and they will have a higher max speed. Try to get the highest score you can.
row.short_description: A skill based game with lots of customizability, where you slash bullets with a sword before they hit the ground, to earn money and get new cosmetics.

row.name: Food Facility
row.detailed_description: Food Facility is a game where you build a complex factory to produce food as efficiently as possible—all within the tight space you're given. Droppers Droppers release ingredients that can be combined, compressed, mixed, and more. Discover multiple ways to transform these items into food products. Combine things! Take ingredients from your droppers and feed them into machines like the Mixer—combine flour and sugar into dry mix, or experiment with more advanced machines as your factory grows. Tiers Unlock tiers to progress your factory! Discover hidden recipes and occasionally new machinery as you advance. Shop Ingredients don’t appear out of nowhere! Buy what you need to keep your factory running. Contracts Take on contracts to boost your factory’s profits and earn even more!
row.short_description: Food Facility is a 2D factory automation game where you design and build complex production lines to create delicious food, sell your goods, and grow your business empire!

row.name: Rocrasher
row.detailed_description: Rocrasher（大石头杀人事件） PUSH and SMASH!!! Savor the ultimate thrill of crushing everything in your way! Crushing the little figures along the road will increase the boulder's size and weight, granting it greater acceleration and diving force! Multiple Levels to Choose From Each stage offers a unique style — from the surface to the underground, roll your way through and crush everything in your path. Satisfying Physics and Collision Feedback Experience dynamic physics-based destruction. The way objects shatter depends on what you hit and how fast you crash into it, giving each impact a different level of feedback. Various Interactive Mechanics Want to clear the road for your giant boulder? Try out different abilities at your disposal: 1 Tap the boulder to push it in any direction. 2 Tap obstacles to smash them apart. 3 Crush as many little critters as you can. Charming Cartoon Art Style & Immersive Audio-Visuals A cute and quirky giant boulder, swaying grass and flowers, bouncing roaches — all enhanced by post-processing filters, outlines, sound effects, and screen shake. Together they create an engaging and stress-relieving audiovisual experience.
row.short_description: PUSH and SMASH!!! Savor the ultimate thrill of crushing everything in your way! Crushing the little figures along the road will increase the boulder's size and weight, granting it greater acceleration and diving force!

row.name: Grind Hero: MMORPG
row.detailed_description: GRIND HERO – 2D CROSS-PLATFORM MMORPG WITH PVP, GUILDS AND EPIC ADVENTURES! Get ready to dive into a nostalgic and challenging world in GRIND HERO – a 2D MMORPG made for players who love leveling up characters, exploring vast maps, and testing their skills in intense PvP battles! PLAY ANYWHERE Grind Hero is fully cross-platform, allowing you to play with the same account on both PC and mobile. Take your adventure with you wherever you go! CLASSES AND EVOLUTION Choose from 4 unique classes and unlock a powerful upgrade upon reaching level 20. Each class has its own playstyle, abilities, and battlefield role! PARTIES AND GUILDS Form parties with your friends or team up with other adventurers! Join a guild to take part in exclusive events, conquer territories, and grow as a team. PVP WITH SKULL SYSTEM Engage in PvP combat in dedicated areas! The skull system marks player killers, adding more risk and strategy to every encounter. AUTOMATED BOSS EVENTS Prepare for epic battles against bosses that spawn automatically across the world! Team up and fight for rare loot and glory. SIGIL SYSTEM Unlock and equip Sigils – unique passive abilities that enhance your strength, defense, speed, regeneration, and more. Customize your build to match your playstyle. SKILL TRAINING SYSTEM Leveling up is only part of the journey. Train your skills over time to become stronger and more efficient in combat. A VAST WORLD FULL OF SECRETS Explore a huge open world with diverse regions, immersive quests, hidden chests, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. There’s always something new to discover! MAIN FEATURES: • Lightweight and addictive 2D MMORPG • Full cross-platform support (PC and Mobile) • Party and guild systems • PvP with skull system • 4 classes with evolution at level 20 • Passive Sigils for deep customization • Automated world boss events • Real-time skill training • Open map with quests, chests, and hidden content Love grinding, exploring, fighting bosses and becoming a legend in a nostalgic 2D world? Grind Hero is for you! Download now and begin your journey!
row.short_description: 2D MMORPG with PvP, guilds, bosses, sigils, and a vast world to explore!

row.name: Resonance Solstice
row.detailed_description: Dear Conductor, finally we meet! Resonance Solstice is a unique real-time trading RPG that combines real-time card battles with train simulation gameplay. As a conductor for COLUMBA, you’ll drive your train across the continent, reconnecting cities and regions to save a world on the brink of collapse. In this world full of unknowns, you'll meet companions from different factions, each with unique personalities, and together you'll face the adventures and challenges that come your way during your journey. ===Drive the Eternal at full speed=== Drive the Eternal across ' Morphic Field Pollution' zones and travel through the beautiful post-catastrophe landscapes. Start the engine and reconnect the world rendered in shambles. ===Design and Manage Your Dream Train Home=== Customize the Eternal however you like and turn it into your personal movable home on rails. With diverse styles, enjoy the adventure in your own unique way! ===Real-Time Trading, Wealth Incoming=== Ports, cities, and the wilds — dynamic markets where you buy low and sell high! Trade across cities in real time and become the world’s top merchant! ===Real-Time Card Battles with Endless Combinations=== Engage in thrilling card battles in real time. With flexible team-building and countless card synergies, craft your exclusive squad and dominate the battlefield your way! ===Top-Tier Voice Actors for Anime-Style Immersion=== Every character features Live2D interaction and premium Japanese voice acting! Encounter unforgettable allies and dive into an anime-quality, story-rich journey! Voice Actor Cast: Kitō Akari, Mizuki Nana, Kugimiya Rie, Tomatsu Haruka, Sugita Tomokazu, Ishida Akira, Morikawa Toshiyuki, Matsuoka Yoshitsugu, Uchiyama Kōki, Ōnishi Saori, Murase Ayumu, Enoki Junya, Toyoguchi Megumi, Honda Mariko, Kanemoto Hisako, Tamura Yukari, Maeda Kaori, Uchida Aya, Ise Mariya, Kuroki Honoka, Numakura Manami, Nakahara Mai, Senbongi Sayaka, Yumiri Hanamori, Taketatsu Ayana, Kohara Konomi, Yukana, Maria Naganawa, Sonozaki Mie, Asumi Kana, M・A・O, Machico, Tachibana Mirai, Itō Shizuka, Tadokoro Azusa, Itō Miku, Mamiya Tomoaki ===World Settings=== When the unknown object 'Morphic Moon' appeared in the sky, everything we once knew changed. The world was thrown into disarray, with conflicting factions and chaos spreading through every corner of the cities. In Resonance, humanity succumbed to slumber, transmuting into dream-drunk entities beyond mortal recognition. In this remade reality,‌ as a Conductor of COLUMBA,‌ where shall you steer your Train —‌ the lifeline threading between Bonfire Cities' final hopes? All aboard! Take the controls of your own Eternal and ride across a world slipping into chaos!
row.short_description: Resonance is a unique real-time trading RPG that combines real-time card battles with train simulation. As a COLUMBA conductor, you’ll travel the continent, rebuild and reconnect a fractured world.
row.notes: Contains content like cartoon or fantasy violence that is not suitable for players under the age of 12.

row.name: PANOPTYCA : Idle RPG Manager
row.detailed_description: Game Overview Step into the role of a commander in a vast fantasy world. Manage, train, and lead your heroes to forge the strongest Alliance squad. Key Features 1. Innovative Multi-Character Management System Unlike traditional RPGs that focus on a single hero, Panoptica allows you to nurture up to eight heroes simultaneously. Each hero explores a different region independently, embarking on their own unique adventure. 2. Real-Time Four-View Battle Observation Mode Through the four-panel Command Mode, you can monitor multiple ongoing battles in real time. Step in instantly during emergencies to adjust your strategy, or focus on upgrading your heroes' equipment and skills when the situation is stable. 3. Party Dungeons While individual heroes hunt autonomously across the field, you can form two-hero parties to challenge high-difficulty dungeons. Experiment with combinations such as tank and DPS, or mage and healer, to defeat powerful bosses that would be impossible to face alone—earning both exciting rewards and the satisfaction of cooperative play. 4. The Essence of Strategic RPG Management Go beyond simple leveling and become a true commander of heroes. Assign characters to optimal battlefields based on their classes and traits, distribute equipment efficiently, and manage skill trees to maximize synergy. With precise auto-battle customization, you can design and control the battlefield exactly as you envision it. The satisfaction of growing up to eight heroes simultaneously delivers a new sense of accomplishment never before felt in traditional RPGs. 5. Aesthetic of Medieval Fantasy and TRPG Charm Featuring parchment-style visuals reminiscent of classic tabletop RPGs, Panoptica digitally recreates the nostalgic feeling of rolling dice with friends around a table. Each region offers its own monsters and treasures, and as your exploration deepens, a richer world and lore unfold before you.
row.short_description: Discover a new style of RPG management gameplay. Experience the fun of an idle RPG that blends an innovative four-view battle system with a deep hero-growth mechanic.

row.name: Quiz Pinball: The Quiz You Didn't Know You Needed
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the must-play quiz for every pinball fan! Explore unexpected stories, iconic machines, legendary manufacturers… and a few tricky surprises along the way. Dive into the world of pinball and find out if your knowledge matches your reflexes! Some example questions: Which pinball personality appears on the Back to the Future flyer? Which city is considered the birthplace of pinball? What object is above the central spinner on the Tales of the Arabian Nights pinball? What do you call a pinball enthusiast? And much more …
row.short_description: Welcome to the must-play quiz for every pinball fan! Explore unexpected stories, iconic machines, legendary manufacturers… and a few tricky surprises along the way. Dive into the world of pinball and find out if your knowledge matches your reflexes!

row.name: Scaredy Cat
row.detailed_description: Scaredy Cat is a short, emotional narrative adventure where you play as a young kitty trying to prove she’s brave enough to cross the darkest part of the forest to find a rare flower alone. A journey that starts as a simple dare quickly becomes something deeper, as kitty meets the inhabitants of the forest and has to face the truth about herself.  Key Features A short but heartfelt experience (~10–20 minutes); Explore stylized locations of the game world; Funny dialogue and interesting story twists; Simple controls, accessible to all players. The game was made as a part of a Summer Studies course at Kajaani University of Applied Sciences in just a few months. This is out first Steam release! :)
row.short_description: A scaredy cat steps into the forest alone to find a rare flower for her friends — but some journeys are more than they seem.

row.name: THUGGING
row.detailed_description: THUGGING is a third-person shoot ’em up set in a lawless city where crime, drugs, and gambling control everything. The streets are stained with blood, and only the most ruthless make it out alive. Revenge, Retribution and maybe ... a second chance? You’re fresh out of prison with one thing on your mind — revenge. The city that turned its back on you hasn’t changed, and it’s still crawling with thugs, gangs, and dirty criminals standing in your way. With weapons in hand and nothing to lose, you’ll fight your way through the streets, leaving chaos behind as you climb back to the top. The only question is, how far will you go for revenge and how much drug money can you steal?! Features:  Shoot, Steal, Survive – Engage in relentless 3rd Person shootouts, kill armed thugs, and keep stacking dirty cash in your hideout Muscle Car Rides – Cruise the city in style, traveling from one place to another while catching your breath between fights and discovering your old town Revenge-Driven Story – Fresh out of jail, with nothing left to lose, your future is written in bullets and blood This isn't just survival; it's about taking back what's yours. Your story is one of blood, bullets and drug money. The city offers no mercy and neither will you!
row.short_description: THUGGING is a 3rd Person Shoot 'em up set in a dystopian city fueled by drugs and gambling. Inspired by classic 3D retro games it tries to capture this unique oldschool ambient in a semi open world setting. Steal money, kill thugs and get away in your car!
row.notes: - Explict Violence as means to reach the Game Goals showing blood, violent kills and executions - the Story depicts death, betrayal, revenge and violence inside the drug/ narcotics trade - a nightmarish alter ego leads the Player through the game almost like a narrator - illegal drugs are shown as a commodity but can not be used by the Player intentionally - casual consumption of alcohol and tobacco are implied but can not be actively engaged with by the Player

row.name: 小王子
row.detailed_description: A puzzle game in a watercolor style, where players need to complete puzzles by clicking or dragging with the mouse. The presentation format mimics children's picture books, with different scenes displayed in a paged format. Take you back to the story of the classic work 'The Little Prince'!
row.short_description: A puzzle game in a watercolor style, where players need to complete puzzles by clicking or dragging with the mouse. The presentation format mimics children's picture books, with different scenes displayed in a paged format. Take you back to the story of the classic work 'The Little Prince'!

row.name: Blightfell
row.detailed_description: Deckbuild Choose a House and assemble your deck to define your own playstyle. Strategize Summon minions to your field to create powerful combos and prepare for battle Combat Watch your strategy unfold as your minions clash against an opponent's. Eliminate them to move one step closer to victory!
row.short_description: Choose your house, build a unique deck, and summon powerful minions to claim victory in BLIGHTFELL, a card-battler full of tight decision-making and strategic depth.

row.name: License to Grill
row.detailed_description: License to Grill is a multiplayer 3rd Person Combat game with up to 8 players . Your goal is to cook your friends in Free For All matches. Take advantage of wacky ragdoll physics to knock your friends into an an oven or tenderize them with a big hammer! Use a variety of wacky and powerful weapons to cook your friends in creative ways. Each weapon has something special about it. Each weapon will heat up your opponents, eventually cooking them! Frying Pan Your trusty default weapon that always comes back to you even after being thrown. Meat Hammer A devastating Meat Tenderizer that can slam the ground with incredible power that can knock players around. Pepper Shotgun A powerful shotgun with strong knockback that can easily cook other players with a regular shot or a charged shot that uses more ammo. Fridge Door A riot shield style weapon that you can use to cool yourself faster and defend from frontal attacks as well as thrust forward with incredible speed. Propane Launcher A grenade launcher style weapon that fires 2 highly explosive propane tanks at once that leave fire at the point of impact. Navigate interesting level layouts that provide plenty of opportunities for riveting interactions. Pizza Party A tight pizza kitchen inspired environment with a conveyor belt covered in weapons leading to a giant pizza oven that will cook you if fall in. Market Showdown A food market street inspired environment with a hot charcoal grill spilled in the middle of the map. Market Showdown has lots of vertical space and cover to take advantage of.  Cook the most players in a match to score the most and win !
row.short_description: Pick your favorite meat character and cook up to 8 friends using the environment, wacky weapons, or your trusty frying pan in this online 3rd Person Combat PVP game!

row.name: The Most Epicest Snowball Fight Ever!
row.detailed_description: It's a beautiful, snowy day in the neighborhood. School's cancelled, so it's time for a snowball fight! Play as a group of friends taking up the mantle of defending their homes from imaginary monsters with nothing but snowballs, cocoa, and their wild imaginations. Immerse yourself in a rich and rewarding tactical experience! Take cover behind the environment to protect yourself, focus fire to stop monsters from regenerating, and more! As you fight, your imagination will begin to run wild. With this power, you can bring imagination to life! Soar through the air, create the ultimate unbreakable anti-everything shield, and more! After each level, choose three new powers to add to your team! There's no wrong answers, so let your imagination run wild as you prepare to face the endless hordes of snow monsters!
row.short_description: The snowball fight of your dreams! Take up arms against imaginary snow monsters in this charming turn-based tactics game where a child's imagination is their greatest weapon. Can you defeat the forces of the evil Baron von Slushie?

row.name: FOR GOD'S SAKE, HELP HIM!

row.name: HEGGO
row.detailed_description: This project is a free game created by the developer out of personal interest and as a portfolio piece. The game took three months to complete, with all music, art, programming, and writing created independently by the developer. In the game, the protagonist plays as an egg kid who was executed by the king and sent to hell. Seeking revenge, they make a deal with a demon to assist in their plans. Inspiration was drawn from games like Lone Star Hunter, The Binding of Isaac, Bratato, and Slay the Spire. The game adds a time-based resource mechanic to the traditional roguelike genre, allowing players to dynamically allocate the number of monsters each round. The initial difficulty is high, requiring multiple attempts to gradually unlock the monster and item bestiary, gaining off-round growth and enhancing base stats. Once all equipment bestiary are unlocked, players can customize their starting gear, which changes the gameplay by focusing less on survival and more on gear-building. The game also pays homage to some well-known games' items or characters, offering surprises for players. The main game takes about one to two hours to complete, while the full achievement run takes approximately five to ten hours. We hope players find joy in the experience. row.name: Solar Knight
row.detailed_description: Join forces with Sir Lionel Lancelot De L’Arc — a knight of the Bourbon Roundtable, falsely branded a murderer of the King and Queen. Despised and pursued by the land he once served, Lionel fights to uncover the truth, expose the real killers, and reclaim his shattered honor. YOKAI: The Lighting-Fast Sword Cut through enemies in a relentless flurry of speed and precision — a ruthless dance of death so swift, so merciless, it ends before your foes even realize it has begun. Unleash a blinding surge of divine fury that tears through the shadows, staggering foes and leaving them helpless before your wrath. Unleash a thunderous upward slash — a defiant arc of steel that rips through flesh, shatters will, and severs the very thread of fate. SANGUIN: The Blood-Frenzy Sword Every strike is a sweeping answer to chaos — deliberate, unhurried, and inevitable, punishing all who dare remain within its path. Ignite your blade with blood flame, searing through flesh and branding each wound with unending pain — a slow, crimson torment that bleeds enemies dry from the inside out. With a thunderous crash of steel and fury, he hurls his armored shoulder into the fray — breaking ranks, shattering bones, and crushing the will to stand. TRAVERSAL: Turn obstacles into opportunity — dash along walls with fearless precision, defying the ground beneath and ascending into places no blade was ever meant to tread, where danger hides and legends are born. Where nature builds its tallest walls to keep you caged, you rise — clawing past wind, stone, and gravity itself, climbing toward places never meant to be touched by mortal hands. The road ahead is not a path, but a test — where even solid ground deceives, and every step could be your last. The world wants you dead . The truth wants to stay buried . But your blade speaks louder than lies. Hunt the guilty , fight the impossible , and reclaim a name forged in steel .

row.name: 英雄之城3
row.detailed_description: Dear lord, welcome to City of Heroes 3, an epic war strategy feast! This game is like an encyclopedia of ancient civilizations. Open it and you will experience the rise and struggle of ancient civilizations. Let's put modern technology aside and go back to the old days to enjoy the luxuries of the Middle Ages. In this game, you'll tour the seven continents and choose a place to develop - is it China? Rome? Egypt? Or Persia? It's up to you, my lord! But don't think that this is just a construction simulation game. You need to gather heroes and soldiers, skillfully deploy various types of units and formations, and sometimes even defeat a superior enemy. In this world, you can also participate in various quests to build houses, cultivate fields, run farms, upgrade buildings and so on. Every time you complete a quest, you will be rewarded with generous rewards, which will make you more motivated to conquer in the world. What are you waiting for? Sign up for City of Heroes 3 now and experience the fierce battles of history! Not only can you conquer the world, but also enjoy the fun of the Middle Ages and make your friends feel envious! Developer's Words City of Heroes 3 is an immersive strategy and tactics game that we are committed to making easy for every player to enjoy. In this game, you will return to ancient times and build your own civilization. Firstly, we will provide a vast world with a real map of seven continents waiting for you to explore. You can choose your own territory, develop internal affairs and diplomacy, build cities, train armies, and become the founder of a civilization. Secondly, the game focuses on historical restoration. You will fight with many epic heroes to recreate the glory of the ancient cities. These heroes have unique skills and potentials, and will be a powerful support for your army. Historical cities await your rule and are full of resources and opportunities. In the game, you will face a variety of units and formations, and the choice of war strategy will determine the victory or defeat. We encourage players to gain victory through wisdom and strategy, not just numerical values. Most importantly, we always insist on fair competition, no VIP privileges and no brainless numerical competition. What City of Heroes 3 really tests is your strategic intelligence and teamwork. We want every player to be able to engage in the game easily and enjoy the challenges and achievements. In short, our goal is to create a game that is approachable and allows players to experience the fun of strategy games. Whether you are a novice or a veteran, you can find fun and challenges in City of Heroes 3.

row.name: Conquer the Tower
row.detailed_description: 👀 Seventeen, all out. Sacrificed my holiday, rushed against time, all for the dream of the game. This game may not be serious enough or perfect, but my love and focus on the game are always implemented in all the game content! Please support me, I will work harder to chase my gaming dream! Your support will have a profound impact on a high school student. 💀A tale of pursuing freedom and liberation, a tale of falling into oppression and enslavement... Take your friends, escape the prison, climb the Tower of Babel... in short, march toward the long-awaited yet paralyzing truth. 😽Bring your family, friends, classmates—or enjoy it alone... The game is designed for both solo and multiplayer experiences, but the multiplayer mode adds a unique ability: attracting or repelling your teammates like magnets. So bring your friends —this feature guarantees hilarious trolling moments and lots of laughter (confirm). 🤪 Novel mechanics—does physics even exist anymore... Polarity : Players are either positively charged (blue) or negatively charged (red), and can switch between them. Charge Ring : Each player is encircled by a visible (but intangible) ring that displays their current polarity in real time. Color Blocks : Opposites attract, likes repel—map blocks will pull in players of the opposite charge and push away those with the same charge. Magnetism : When multiple players join, you can press a button to attract or repel a teammate—whether to help a friend in need... or just to mess with them. Note that attraction will be automatically activated when you are too far away from your friends, and the same applies when you are too close. Climbing : Aim at the platform's edge, dash, and spam the jump button to scale that damn platform!!!🧗‍♀️ 🤡 The Benevolent 'Save' System, Protecting You All the Way... Spawn Phantom : Spend Meme Coins to leave a traceable phantom (aka a checkpoint but decide on u😁) behind. In plain terms? It’s a save point. As for what 'rewind' means—keep reading. Rewind Phantom : This is an upward-climbing game. If you fall? No worries—just spend Meme Coins to rewind to a previously split phantom. And what are Meme Coins? Well... keep scrolling. Collect Meme Coins : Used to cover the cost of splitting or rewinding phantoms. They’re everywhere on the map—but if your friend grabs them first, they’re gone. Remember: winners take all. 👌 Flexible Difficulty—All Based on Your Choices... [Cute] Difficulty : You spent so many Meme Coins that you went into debt , proving your gameplay is adorably clumsy. The game will proudly display your [Cute] title. Congrats! You’ll get a 'Cute' clear rating. But hey, clearing the game is what matters—don’t sweat it. [Virus] Difficulty : Your Meme Coin count stays between 0–12 , showing you’ve got real skill. Your friends will see your [Virus] title. Congrats! You’re as relentless and unstoppable as certain [viruses] . [Bot] Difficulty : Your Meme Coins exceed 12 , marking you as an absolute legend—smart as cutting-edge AI. Congrats! Flaunt that [Bot] title and flex on your friends. [iZoy_] Difficulty : 'Who’s iZoy_?' Check the dev credit (facepalm) 😚 . You didn’t spend a single Meme Coin—relying purely on skill, precision, grit, patience, and raw mastery, without using [Split Phantom] or [Rewind Phantom] even once. This difficulty & title means you outplayed the dev, matching my iron will! 😉This is the  hardest challenge , the highest honor . Now—stay focused, and let no mistake derail your ascension to godhood ! Wish  my game bring you joy! That’s it.

row.detailed_description: Master a deck-building card game where strategy, power, and destiny collide. In a world where all conflict is settled by the divine game of Dobro Goranku, every card you play shapes the future. Build your deck, challenge rivals, and seize control of fate itself. A World Forged by a Card Game. When endless wars threatened to tear the world of Turiya apart, a God intervened with a single, unbreakable rule: all disputes, from the fate of empires to bitter personal rivalries, would be decided by a sacred card game—Dobro Goranku. In this new era, strategy is your weapon, and the deck is your army. Those who control the cards, control destiny itself. Your path to victory starts with strategic deck-building. You must master the six core elements— Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, and Darkness —to outwit your opponents. Each round is governed by a random element. If your card matches the active element, you secure a guaranteed victory for the turn. But if both players match—or neither do—the true test of power begins. In this scenario, victory goes to the player whose card has the higher stat linked to the round’s governing element. Evolve Your Power, Claim Your Legacy Dobro Goranku is more than just a simple battle. Your cards are a living arsenal designed to evolve. They will level up, gain new stats, and grow immensely more powerful with every duel you win. Matches are swift and decisive, concluding in just five rounds. The player who accumulates the most points doesn’t just win—they claim rewards that transcend simple victory, fueling their ongoing progression. Test your skills against an advanced AI designed to challenge you at every turn. Battle players from around the world and climb the global leaderboard to prove your strategic mastery. Evolve your cards, unlock powerful improvements, and constantly customise your deck to perfect your playstyle. Master the distinct mechanics and synergies of Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, and Darkness. Jump into quick, engaging battles that are easy to learn but offer deep strategic challenges. Dobro Goranku is the ultimate experience for: Fans of competitive TCGs and turn-based strategy games. Players who love the deep satisfaction of deck-building, climbing leaderboards, and perfecting their personal strategies. Anyone seeking a competitive game with simple, fun, and highly engaging mechanics. Dobro Goranku will be available in multiple languages, including English, Portuguese, and Spanish.

Originally developed as a student project at Carnegie Mellon University’s Entertainment Technology Center, this prototype showcases a rich narrative and magic-based gameplay wrapped in an atmospheric experience. As the journey unfolds, players will fight through ancient temples, rescue imprisoned Druids, and confront the Blood Druid in a climactic showdown. Every spell is designed with dual purpose—use magic not just to fight, but to unlock paths, trigger platforming mechanics, and interact meaningfully with the world. Features Single-player action-adventure gameplay with controller support Puzzle-solving through multi-use magic mechanics A branching world of temples, elemental environments, and narrative-driven quests Atmospheric soundtrack, handcrafted VFX, and immersive level design Developed in Unity 6 with the Penguin Action Toolkit About the Team The Tale of Oath was developed by Ashling Tu and Team Quessant, a passionate group of graduate students at Carnegie Mellon University for the Level Design Production project. The project was guided by instructors Ruth Comley and Ricardo Washington, with expert insight from SME Ketul Majmudar and consultant Michael Christel. row.name: Song of Nanzhao
row.detailed_description: Song of Nanzhao is a music-driven puzzle game inspired by traditional Chinese folk music, particularly the Nanzhao Fengsheng music. This vertical slice presents the first chapter of the game. In the year 798 AD, war swept across the land. The Tang Dynasty launched massive conscription campaigns, leaving border kingdoms in turmoil. For years, the Nanzhao Kingdom clashed with the Tang in endless conflict. Born into this chaos, you are a court musician—silent by birth, but never voiceless. With music as your only bridge to the world, you must carry the hope of a nation longing for peace. Wander through an ancient Chinese village during a time of war. Meet villagers shaped by hardship, uncover their personal stories, and build trust through empathy and kindness. Use music to interact with people and the world around you. Every object has its own sound. Listen closely, and you’ll hear melodies hidden in the world. Learn and record these melodies using a pentatonic system based on the five elements. Each note is a tool—helping you speak, unlock secrets, and gather key items. Use your music to solve puzzles, unlock forgotten memories, and progress through the story. Whether you're delivering the right tune to a villager or playing a melody to open sealed paths, every note you play brings you one step closer to understanding the past—and shaping what’s to come. As the musician of Nanzhao, your melodies carry more than sound—they carry meaning, memory, and hope. In a world scarred by war, can music offer a path to peace?
row.short_description: Song of Nanzhao is a music-driven puzzle adventure set in ancient China. As a voiceless court musician, use pentatonic melodies drawn from nature to solve puzzles, uncover hidden stories, and connect with villagers, seeking peace through the power of sound.

row.name: The Crawling Dead
row.detailed_description: The Crawling Dead is a strategy simulation game where you take on the role of a lead scientist tasked with saving Stormveil National Park from ecological collapse. Swarms of invasive insects are devastating the park’s delicate ecosystems, and traditional methods of pest control have failed. Your solution? Genetically engineered parasitoid wasps. Harmless to humans, these beneficial wasps are killers of pest insects and utilize a variety of creepy strategies to manipulate and kill their hosts - turning them into The Crawling Dead! Design and deploy a variety of specialized wasps to target different invasive species, adapting to changing seasons, terrain types, and resistance patterns. From alpine meadows to desert canyons, each biome presents unique challenges and different pest insects that require careful planning and scientific precision. Create the most efficient and effective parasitoid wasps to save the national park and restore ecological harmony. Balance science, speed, and strategy as you guide the park’s recovery from spring through the first snowfall of winter. Every wasp release counts. Every adaptation matters. And if your wasps fail, the invasive wave of pest insects will damage the ecosystem for good. Will your engineered wasps be enough to turn the tide? FEATURES A fun, interactive main game mode Design Lab with a trait tree and customizable wasps Six unique minigames Three difficulty levels Eighteen achievements Weather hazards Adaptive news feed Many possible strategies In-depth statistic tracking Original art and soundtrack Educational elements for learning about parasitic wasps
row.short_description: Design, deploy, and manage the release of parasitic wasps to save a national park from invasive insect pests. Harness the power of nature’s most efficient killers to strike back at the invaders and turn them into The Crawling Dead!

row.name: War of Dots
row.detailed_description: Overview War of Dots is a minimalist real-time strategy game. Command your armies in real-time battles across a variety of maps. Capture cities, manage resources, and defeat your rivals. Game Details The key idea in War of Dots is simplicity. Unlike most other strategy games, it doesn’t rely on complex mechanics. There are only two types of units: light – perfect for fighting in numbers, effective in most terrains, and cheaper to produce; and heavy – slower and less maneuverable, effective only in clear terrain, but with high damage and health, making them ideal for breakthroughs and impenetrable defenses. The economy is just as simple. Cities produce new units and supply existing ones. Each city supports up to five units; if there are more, the excess units will starve. By capturing cities, you gain an economic advantage over your opponent. That’s all you need to know! Download the game and prove your place in history alongside legends like Napoleon and Alexander the Great. Key Features Real-Time Tactical Combat: Command your armies, manage resources, and strike at the perfect moment. Fast-Paced Multiplayer: Jump into solo or team-based matches with other players online. Minimalist Interface: Clean visuals focus on clarity, showing only what you need to make strategic decisions. Multiple Game Modes: Includes ranked PvP, casual matches, and custom map creation. Instant Replay: Review matches with full replays showing both your moves and your opponent’s. Simple to Learn, Hard to Master: Easy for new players to pick up, with deep tactical mechanics that reward skill and planning. Why You’ll Love It War of Dots captures the thrill of classic RTS gameplay in a fresh, abstract package. With short match durations, smart mechanics, and competitive depth, it’s both accessible and endlessly engaging—perfect for players who crave strategic challenge in quick, action-packed sessions. row.detailed_description: 《血战沙城·王者归来》游戏介绍 🎮《血战沙城·王者归来》是一款以经典蓝本，创新融合多元玩法的 185 大极品单职业传奇手游。在这里，玩家将踏入一个充满热血与激情的沙城世界，体验前所未有的极致战斗快感与惊喜连连的冒险之旅。 游戏概述： 🌟版本特色，独树一帜 🎲本服采用 185 大极品设定，随机元素与随机攻击属性相结合，打破传统职业界限，打造单职业职业生态大服。在这里，每个玩家都能找到属于自己的独特战斗风格，享受个性化成长的乐趣。👾小怪爆红包，👹BOSS 爆充值，让玩家在打怪升级的同时，也能收获满满，真正实现“打到手软、散人追梦”的游戏体验。 💥创新玩法，极致体验 🧪在保留原有怀旧元素的基础上，本服大胆创新，引入众多新颖玩法。特色内功元素、魂骨元神系统，让玩家在战斗中能够释放出更加震撼的技能效果；🌏世界 BOSS 挑战，则让玩家有机会与全服高手一同并肩作战，共同争夺丰厚奖励。此外，💀刀刀绿毒、👻元神之力等特色设定，更是让玩家在洗炼超极品元素的过程中，享受单挑一切 BOSS 的畅快淋漓。 🎉丰富活动，福利不断 🏃游戏内活动丰富多样，开区 30 分钟土城跑酷活动，让玩家在紧张刺激的竞速中，轻松获取超多专属福利；🗡专属神器活动，则保证必爆专属武器，让玩家实力瞬间飙升；🏆行会挑战掉落专属称号，更是让玩家在团队中彰显个性与荣耀。此外，还有🚚财宝护送等超多免费福利活动等待玩家自行探索发现。 🛡职业设定，PK 无敌 💪本服职业设定以战士为核心，PK 非常给力，单挑无敌！超多神技加持，让战士在全屏杀怪的过程中，速度 +99，轻松成为战场上的霸主。无论是单挑还是群战，战士都能展现出惊人的战斗力与生存能力，让玩家在享受战斗快感的同时，也能感受到成为王者的荣耀与自豪。 🌳长久耐玩，散人养老 ⚖️本服注重游戏平衡与长久耐玩性，时间为王，人人平等。无论你是散人玩家还是资深大佬，都能在这里找到属于自己的乐趣与挑战。🎁海量超多福利拿到手软，主线任务与上线泡点等设定，更是让玩家在轻松愉快的氛围中，享受游戏带来的无尽欢乐。 🎉《血战沙城·王者归来》是一款呕心巨作，品质保证，长期耐玩的经典传奇手游。更多特色精彩内容，请各位大佬进服自行探索发现！祝您在本服中玩得愉快，成为真正的沙城王者！👑
row.short_description: 《血战沙城·王者归来》是一款以经典蓝本，创新融合多元玩法的 185 大极品单职业传奇手游。在这里，玩家将踏入一个充满热血与激情的沙城世界，体验前所未有的极致战斗快感与惊喜连连的冒险之旅。

row.name: Monsters' Den: Book of Vengeance Playtest
Méli-Mélo : L'odyssée de la crème de marrons
row.detailed_description: 🟣 Méli-Mélo 4: The Odyssey of Chestnut Cream 🟣 Four friends, a jar of chestnut cream, an unlikely quest. Bigflo , Oli , Mcfly & Carlito are stuck on the set of Méli-Mélo, but an essential ingredient has disappeared... chestnut cream! Dive into an original 2D platformer and help our four heroes recover it, level after level. 🎮 Game features: 🧩 Discover several unique levels, full of surprises and references. 🔁 Vary the style of play with a change of character at each level. 🧠 Face amazing mini-bosses and overcome unexpected obstacles. ⏱️ Challenge your friends in speedrun mode: who will finish the fastest? But beware... behind this theft lies an enemy well known to the four friends... and he's greedier than ever! 🧃 Did you know? Méli-Mélo is a YouTube video concept created by the duos Mcfly & Carlito and Bigflo & Oli , in which they have fun surprising each other in a series of mini-games and happenings straight out of the minds of each member of the quartet. Since episode 3, a mysterious jar of chestnut cream has been making an appearance. In episode 4, the surprise is revealed: this jar gives access to a... video game! 🎓 A game imagined by Carlito and developed by students at the Gaming Campus school in Lyon.
row.short_description: Bigflo, Oli, and McFly & Carlito must find a mysterious jar of chestnut cream in a crazy 2D platform game! Switch heroes at each level, face mini-bosses, and embark on a speedrun!

row.name: 名利场:我被好莱坞美女潜规则了 Playtest
Fishing Relax
row.detailed_description: 🏖️ Escape to a paradisiacal island Imagine casting your line into crystal-clear waters, enjoying the sun as you relax fishing. But this isn't just any fishing trip – it's an unforgettable adventure! After being separated from your soulmate by some mysterious purple light, you become friends with Fongfan, a dragon whelp. Explore the world, complete quests and unlock achievements! Help Fongfan to transform into an adult dragon and unravel the mystery of the purple lights. Reel in rare fish and story-rich treasures, and compare your collection with your friends! Play without an account, or sign in to save your progress across all your devices. Just the game to relax and live a memorable adventure. 🕹️ Easy to play Click on a fish to begin fishing. Hold the reel to fish faster. 🏆 Fish them all! Collect more than 90 treasures that have been teleported to your planet by the mysterious purple lights. 🎒 Visit your friend's inventory Compare your collection with your friends! 🐉 Help a dragon Help a dragon whelp transform into a fully grown dragon by completing quests. 🐟 Fish activity surge Fish more and faster during the first five minutes of every hour. ✨ Collector effect The more treasures you collect, the more frequently rarer ones will show up. 🎮 Early access I am working on new game content. Visuals have been created with the use of AI. I would love to work with an artist, but I don't have the budget yet.
row.short_description: 🏝️ A tropical fantasy fishing RPG. 🐠 Reel in rare fish and story-rich treasures from different universes. 🐉 Help a dragon whelp to transform into a fully grown dragon. 🏆 And compare your collection with your friends!

row.name: Typing Fireworks
row.detailed_description: Typing Fireworks（指尖烟花） MOVE! CROUCH! BOOM! Only move to adjacent keys. Moving over keys will make you trip and fall! Press and hold your current key to crouch and light the fuse. Crucial! After igniting the fuse, make sure to escape the danger zone before it explodes! Watch the Fireworks! When fireworks light up the sky, press and hold the SPACE to look up and enjoy the show. Pro Tip: You'll earn bonus points for watching! Watch your step! Random tiles will break! Stepping on them will make you trip, fall, and lose points! Plan your path! The aim is higher scores!
row.short_description: Typing Fireworks is a casual game where your fingers run across the keyboard to set off fireworks! You can only move to adjacent keys, escape the danger zone before the fuse burns out, and look up to enjoy the dazzling display when the fireworks bloom!

row.name: 空王座 Empty Throne
row.detailed_description: Contact Discord:  About the Game Story I was once merely a composer, commissioned by the royal court to score the 'tale' of the Snow Queen. Yet this manuscript appears to exist in multiple iterations. Some versions echo through city streets, while others lie buried beneath forest loam. She claims it to be her autobiography. The magic mirror, however, insists these are merely the chapters she wishes you to remember. I compose melodies. I unravel mysteries. Key Features Distinctive Visual Aesthetic - A unique art style blending pixel art with fantasy elements, crafting an atmospheric dark fairy tale world Ensemble Narrative Design - Multiple interconnected storylines woven together through diverse, compelling characters with distinct personalities Immersive Musical Gameplay - Dynamic music game sequences that heighten narrative tension and deliver emotional crescendos Original Soundtrack - Meticulously composed music tailored specifically for the game experience Interactive Fiction Elements Scene-based interactive puzzles Use the mirror to uncover the truth Rhythm Game Integration Development Team huxx - Game Design & Programming 'Dual-discipline developer specializing in design and technical implementation' 沐风沐 - Game Design 'Wielding the mystical ability to challenge programmers and stress artists to their creative limits' 骷髅男 - Game Design & Art 'Visual artist pushing creative boundaries' 楚狈良 - Game Design & Art 'Design-focused artist bridging creative vision and visual execution' S.W.Diversity Studio (Music Team) Developer's Note Thank you for your interest in Empty Throne . Empty Throne Studio represents an independent development collective comprised of university students who have dedicated their passion and spare time to game creation. Through perseverance and shared vision, we have brought our inaugural project to fruition. Empty Throne marks our debut formal release. While we acknowledge areas for improvement, this project embodies our complete creative dedication and technical commitment. We take pride in presenting our first fully-realized interactive experience. This journey represents both an ambitious creative undertaking and a collaborative adventure shared between developers and players. We invite you to explore this world we've crafted and hope Empty Throne delivers a memorable, atmospheric, and emotionally resonant gaming experience. Thank you for joining us on this narrative adventure.
row.short_description: Empty Throne is a dark fairytale puzzle game. Compose the Snow Queen’s tale in music. Truth twists through alley whispers and forest echoes. The throne lies empty. The mirror speaks. Who writes the ending—you, or the lie?

row.name: State of Survival: Last Warrior
row.detailed_description: The zombie virus has swept the world and survivors have built shelters to fight back! It's a new post-apocalyptic survival strategy building game! Use your wits and bravery to strengthen the shelters and save more humans. Recruit powerful heroes to help you explore the post-apocalyptic world and find strong survivors to form a defense alliance. In the game you can experience simulation construction, map exploration, material collection, army recruitment, destroy zombie lords and other gameplay. Strengthen your shelter, build an invincible army and become a hero of the end of the world to shelter humanity.
row.short_description: Build a shelter to fend off the zombies and survive in the apocalypse

row.name: My Desktop Puppy: 我的桌面小狗 Playtest
Tai Chi Like
row.detailed_description: Tai Chi Like is your pocket guide to quick, mindful movement and meditation—no deep training required. In just five minutes, you’ll experience a randomized sequence of nine simple moves, each paired with a practical strategy to help you stay grounded, centered, and energized throughout your day. There is a button for Move Meditation, a game, Qigong, and Sleep/Study mode all based on the idea of 4 elements with different forms of expression.
row.short_description: Tai Chi Like is your pocket guide to quick, mindful movement and meditation—no deep training required. In just five minutes, you’ll experience a randomized sequence of nine simple moves, each paired with a practical strategy to help you stay grounded, centered, and energized throughout your day.

row.name: SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN
row.detailed_description: Get ready to rumble on the dancefloor! SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN  catapults you into frantic, head-to-head rhythm battles - no holds barred flamboyant theatrics. Hit each beat on time to boost your popularity and charge your special meter, but miss a step and you'll stumble and lose your mojo. Rig the odds with crazy accessories! After every showdown, choose from a random selection of nearly 50 unique accessories. Will you choose to supercharge your moves or unleash clever tricks to troll your rival? Each run shuffles the stakes, with different tracks and builds to play - turning each and every match into a brand-new dance spectacle. It's a roguelite remix of rhythm that keeps you on your toes! Two rival dancers, endless competition! Face off locally against a friend as rival dancers hungry for stardom. Shuffle Showdown is designed to be played as couch PvP, so whether you're nailing combos or sabotaging your opponent you can be sure to expect taunts, reversals and one-upmanship as you out-dance, out-play and out-shuffle your opponent! Groove to an original funky soundtrack! The 100% original score pumps adrenaline through every face-off. Each track is engineered to sync with the rhythm and your moves, so feel the beat and let the music fuel your next show-stealing combo. Infinite remix-ability! With randomised accessories and tracks, every showdown hits differently. Master the meta and discover new synergies to keep the dancefloor unpredictable - then jump straight back in and shake  shuffle things up all over again! About the team SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN  is developed by Team Roland, and was born out of a university project gone much, much too far. We wanted to take our passion for creating games that make players feel excited (and occasionally crash out on their friends) and share it for free with anyone who might find it on Steam. Please forgive us if there are any bugs; as this is our first time shipping a game, SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN may have some technical issues we are unaware of. Many times the fix is as simple as restarting the game - sorry for the inconvenience. Thank you so much for playing and we hope you have fun!
row.short_description: Wacky rhythm action meets roguelike randomness! Every clash shuffles in new buffs and trolls, causing crazy rhythm chaos! Face off in 2-player local PvP and groove to a funky soundtrack with 10 original tracks designed to get you jamming and slamming (your controller!)

row.name: PolyLumina
row.detailed_description: Polylumina is a musical simulation and visual sequencer: craft polyrhythmic chord progressions, watch each note pulse and bloom in vibrant patterns, and shape your own luminous symphony. Create custom chord progressions effortlessly-any progression, any key! Tweak visualizers in real time with intuitive controls. Rotate, move and freely explore every pattern.
row.short_description: A colorful rhythm simulation game where you compose polyrhythmic chord progressions and watch them come alive through glowing, reactive visuals.

row.name: Beat of Rebellion
row.detailed_description: Let the Rhythm guide you In Beat of Rebellion , you'll take the role of the Pulsedrifter , a young rebel who struggles to survive in a bleak future. Inside the cyberpunk metropolis of New Nexus , all forms of art are banned, artists are persecuted, and progress has suffocated the soul of humanity. Music is your ally, and the Beat is your weapon. Fight to bring back voice, color, and rhythm to a city cast into silence. Beat your enemies with Melodies Beat of Rebellion blends a rhythmic game with the intensity of an isometric Hack & Slash . Each battle unfolds in arenas where music dictates timing: the closer you time your actions to the Beat , the stronger you become! At the core of the combat system are Melodies : customizable combos where you assign the inputs, creating your own unique and rhythmicfighting style. Discover the Cyberpunk city of New Nexus Journey through the Underbelly of New Nexus : three levels , each with its own environment and increasing BPM . Explore the Underbelly of New Nexus , overcome traps, hack gates, and dash over gaps while following the Beat . Follow the rhythm and dive into the city to meet its inhabitants and uncover its secrets.
row.short_description: Be the voice out of the choir! Beat of Rebellion is an isometric rhythm-based Hack & Slash. Follow the Beat, create your own Melodies and unleash devastating combos to fight against a totalitarian regime in a cyberpunk city.
row.notes: Beat of Rebellion contains strong language, blood, implicit references to drugs.

row.name: Letherfall
row.detailed_description: Letherfall, June 27, 1998. A child is found on the shores of a lake. His eyes wide with terror, his body frozen with fear and cold. Not far from him, dozens of lifeless bodies: Dylan is the only survivor. The police investigate, secret services intervene, but it’s all in vain — the truth lies buried with the corpses and within the twisted corners of young Dylan’s mind. Manhattan, 2018 Dylan still remembers nothing of that tragic night, but terrible nightmares begin to consume his mind. Relentless. Violent. A voice haunts him in his sleep. Just one sentence, repeated over and over: 'Come back to Letherfall.' It sounds like his sister Janie — whose body was the only one never found. Driven by a dark impulse and the guidance of his therapist, Dylan returns to the now-abandoned village. Letherfall is rotten, decayed, silent… but it is not empty. Something is there. Something watching. Something that remembers. Explore a disturbing and decaying environment, through distorted memories, inhuman presences, and unspeakable horrors. Survive, uncover the truth — or lose your mind trying. Letherfall is waiting for you. And this time… no one gets out.
row.short_description: Letherfall is a first-person horror video game with Lovecraftian elements: the player must make their way through monstrous entities and intricate puzzles while exploring the abandoned village of Letherfall. Some nightmares don’t fade. They’re just waiting for you to open the wrong door.
row.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: violence, blood and gore, disturbing imagery, cult-related themes, psychological horror, and references to suicide.

row.name: SCRUB
row.detailed_description: SCRUB은 미래 한국을 기반으로 한 사이버펑크 배경 3D 로그라이트 쿼터뷰 슈팅 게임입니다. 플레이어는 겉으로 보기에는 평범한 청소 회사의 사장이지만 의뢰를 받으면 무엇이든 5 분만에 청소해주는 청부업자입니다. 기업의 증거인멸 의뢰를 받은 플레이어는 거리로 나가 몰려오는 적들을 청소합니다. 특징 로그라이트 진행: 매번 달라지는 무작위 업그레이드 요소로, 플레이할 때마다 새로운 도전이 기다립니다. 다양한 업그레이드: 가까운 거리를 청소하는 화염 탄환부터 범위를 넓게 쓸어 담는 특수 장비까지, 상황에 맞게 무기를 선택하고 강화할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터 성장: 임무를 수행하며 새로운 능력을 해금하고, 더 강력한 ‘청소부’로 성장해 나갑니다. 시간 압박 미션: 모든 임무는 제한 시간 5분 안에 완료해야 하며, 빠른 판단과 효율적인 움직임이 생존을 좌우합니다. 사이버펑크 한국의 거리: 네온사인 가득한 미래 도시, 뒷골목 갱단 등 독특한 세계관 속에서 몰입감 있는 전투를 즐길 수 있습니다. 반복 플레이 가치: 한 번의 시도로는 모든 콘텐츠를 경험하기 어렵습니다. 새로운 무기 조합과 전략을 시험하며 매번 다른 플레이 경험을 제공합니다.
row.short_description: SCRUB은 미래 한국을 기반으로 한 사이버펑크 배경 3D 로그라이트 쿼터뷰 슈팅 게임입니다. 플레이어는 겉으로 보기에는 평범한 청소 회사의 사장이지만 의뢰를 받으면 무엇이든 5 분만에 청소해주는 청부업자입니다. 기업의 증거인멸 의뢰를 받은 플레이어는 거리로 나가 몰려오는 적들을 청소합니다.

row.name: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders Playtest
FoE Remains
row.detailed_description: REMAINS is a mix of genres with its core as a platformer: side view, familiar game mechanics (jumping, climbing stairs). A rich arsenal of weapons plus fights being a crucial part of the game give you vibes of 2D-shooter. Finally, you can take it as a roguelike game with exploring procedurally generated locations, picking locks, gathering loot, leveling up and learning new skills/perks, crafting, trading, etc. The amount of content right now is huge: several large locations with numerous kinds of rooms, almost a hundred types of enemies, about two hundred types of weapons and explosives, dozens of spells, more than sixty perks and plenty of other things. The development is complete, but new versions may appear in the future. Extra content Reforged - A mod that changes many aspects of the game and fixes bugs, made by Kostr184. Extra bunker Rooms - a mod that adds new rooms in military base locations, made by convetangent.
row.short_description: Remains is a hardcore mix of platformer, 2D-shooter and roguelike with RPG elements. Travel around a post-apocalyptic world and explore its various corners, communicate with locals and help them, level up and fight enemies using a vast arsenal of weapons and magic.

row.name: Yuki「清醒梦」
row.detailed_description: Yuki is a narrative horror adventure set in a remote, abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. A story shaped by memory, regret, and choice Words matter. Every conversation and discovery changes how the story unfolds. Three possible endings — each one reflecting your values and decisions. Face the past in fast-paced combat Confront lingering spirits in bullet hell encounters. Fast breakbeats and frenetic rhythms set the pace for intense battles. Unravel the mystery Explore the remains of a closed campus. Piece together the truth through an online chatroom, strange sightings, and whispered regrets. The only demons here are the memories we carry — and the ones we leave behind. An online chatroom filled with rumors. Mysterious sightings no one can explain. A campus abandoned, its classrooms frozen in time. And at the heart of it all — your best friend, missing without a trace. What happened that night before the school closed down? What secrets are still buried in its halls? Move freely through a fully 3D-modeled environment. Interact with characters, examine objects, and solve puzzles to gather clues — each step bringing you closer to the truth. The only demons here are not monsters of flesh and blood, but the echoes of regret left behind. They linger in empty classrooms, drift through silent hallways, and whisper from forgotten corners of the school long after its doors were shut. Each spirit you encounter is bound by unfinished stories, memories that refuse to fade, and choices that can no longer be undone. To move forward, you’ll have to face not just their regrets — but your own.  Words matter. But words alone won’t save you. Confront the lingering spirits, face their relentless attacks in fast-paced bullet hell encounters, and adapt to each situation under pressure. The knowledge you’ve gathered from exploring the campus isn’t just for solving puzzles — it’s your weapon. Piece together what you’ve learned, choose your words wisely, and turn memory itself into your advantage.
row.short_description: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.

row.name: Gravitrix
row.detailed_description: You play as Bucky, styling your way through the alleys and spaces of a very small Pogotown exploring different tricks on your pogostick. Break the boundaries of movement and experience the freedom against the pull of gravity. Collect different costumes and items from the environment. Show you moves in the performance arena. You decide the moves. You make the path. Go Pogo! Gravitrix follows a futuristic comic-book shaded art style to capture the vibrance of the beautiful colors in the game world showcasing the rich, obstacle-filled world of extreme pogosticking. The neon signs, popping visual effects and the bucket-head character are aimed to invoke the spirit of rebelliousness and creativity in your gameplay. Collect coins, props and costumes from the environment. How many tricks can you combine? Can you flip off an edge into a grind? Can you recreate some real pogo tricks? Hop on to the pogo performance arena to show off your style. But remember to rush your bucket-home before it is too late!! Enjoy an intuitive and responsive control system that gives you complete freedom over every movement. It is easy to learn, but challenging to truly master. Gravtrix includes the following gameplay features: Pogo stick jumping mechanic Boost feature that the player can control (based on timing) to jump higher 8 Classic Pogo tricks(inspired from real pogo tricks) 4 advanced tricks (inspired from real pogo tricks but infused with break dance moves) A grind mechanic which lets players grind in a skateboard like fashion using their pogostick on edges and wires Wall bounce mechanic A rocket jump which adds a thrust to the pogo taking it to a ridiculous height A tutorial level, a story-mode level with scripted events and a free-roam mode Gravitrix was created as a semester project by master’s students at the Entertainment Technology Center at Carnegie Mellon University. The game was developed in collaboration with and under the guidance of Xpogo - a company of highly talented individuals who perform real life pogo stunts professionally! The game is a semi-finished version which will possibly get more features and updates in the future.
row.short_description: Gravitrix is an extreme-pogo-sticking 3D sports-platformer dressed in a comic-book art style meant for misfits and rebels looking to unleash their inner pogo spirit in a chaotic, high-flying world full of stunts.

row.name: Taina's Cursed Legacy
row.detailed_description: Fate casts its dice—and I see. I see that you'll take on the role of a girl. Hair like fire, born in a black hut near the graveyard. It's no easy role, and your choices are many: will you be kind and gentle, or wild and willful? Will you serve others, or seek only your own gain? Or maybe you’ll walk a third path… Time will tell. Your fate is yours alone. It depends on you—and your strength. ---- A text-based RPG set in a free-form Slavic fantasy world Unlimited freedom of choice – Every decision shapes the story, creating a unique experience Multiple endings – Unlock different outcomes based on your actions An intriguing story – A tale that changes and deepens with each choice
row.short_description: A text-based RPG with a nonlinear story set in a free Slavic fantasy world. Shape the heroine's character through your choices and unlock multiple endings. Mystery, folklore, and relationships — your fate depends only on you.

row.name: POLYARD
row.detailed_description: Polyard is a dynamic low poly shooter where survival turns into a profitable business. Fend off hordes of zombies, collect resources, exchange them for money and open new arenas to earn even more. The further you go, the more dangerous your opponents become... and the higher the reward.
row.short_description: POLYARD is a fast-paced co-op shooter where you and your friends battle dangerous infected, tactically clearing the area. After the mission, you must quickly evacuate by transport to survive.

row.name: Astral : Steam Edition
row.detailed_description: Astral: Steam Edition is a sandbox about exploration and freedom. Its central mechanic is astral projection: leaving your body to explore the world from a new perspective and interact with what’s around you. The game includes three ways to play: Sandbox – Open-world freeplay with money and shops. Free Build – Unlimited items and full creative freedom.
