row.detailed_description: Content Creation & Streaming Policy We grant permission for individuals to record, stream, and monetize gameplay footage of 'Last Hammashan' on platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Facebook Gaming, and similar services. Last Hammashan is being developed by a solo programmer and on Zero budget. To save the people of his village, He enters the Hammashan castle from which no one returns alive. But he sparks a war for the power of a civilization which the world believed has been annihilated. To force Gideon into entering the Hammashan castle to retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Astrolabe, Greystone takes the people of his village hostages. The Astrolabe was left behind in the castle by the Hammashan civilization. It is the key to their ancient knowledge. When Gideon touches the Astrolabe, it activates and shows him a place unfamiliar to him. He hears a voice calling out: 'Come home Adam!' Gideon discovers that his real name is Adam and that he is the last Hammashan. An entity at the site awakens his Hammashan blood which alerts the tyrant Sevarog who calls upon his generals and orders killing Adam. What is different? Whenever Adam (Gideon) defeats any of Sevarog’s 12 generals, he reclaims the Hammashan powers from them and then he wields it, as well as the fighting style, as his own. Every win means new abilities and a new fighting style. Adam doesn't die, the lesser health he has, the more vulnerable he is. example: when his health is low, even small hits make him kneel for a long time. Example from the gameplay video: In the boss fight video, Adam has already defeated Twinblast and so he reclaimed the Hammashan powers from him and he can wield it as his own. When transformed, Adam moves and fights exactly like Twinblast. That is, he doesn’t just reclaim weapons and powers, he reclaims the fighting style. Adam can also instantly switch between his original powers and transformed powers. At the end of the video, Greystone tries to use his ultimate attack at the same moment Adam reclaims the Hammashan power from him which leaves Greystone frozen as a statue. Adam reclaims the Hammashan sword fighting style and wields it as his own. He uses it to finish Greystone saying to him: grey stone, what a befitting end.

row.name: 我非圣贤 / 我非聖賢
row.detailed_description: Set in an alternate history, this narrative-driven game follows the journey of a male protagonist who rises from a humble study master's son to a powerful figure shaping the fate of the world. The story centers around the protagonist and three female leads, exploring their intricate love-hate relationships and the ups and downs of life. Supporting characters serve primarily as plot devices.
row.short_description: Players will experience intertwined storylines of the male protagonist and three female leads. The male lead features in about half of the narrative, which is told mostly from his perspective. Through the story progression, players will witness a dramatic tale of power, emotion, and destiny.
row.notes: This game is intended for adult players and contains themes of psychological stress, violent undertones, and mild sexual innuendo. It is recommended for players aged 18 and above.

row.name: FIGHT LIKE HELL
row.detailed_description: Introduction Hell has been destroyed, but a new Hell awaits, and what's left behind is far worse than any Slayer or evil of biblical proportions. Enter arenas with aggressive and unforgiving combat which encourage constant motion and pressure. Set up deadly weapon switching combos for maximum damage per second, use your lighthook to quickly move around the map, or deploy stealth to escape a brush with death. Note: FIGHT LIKE HELL contains only comical violence and contains no blood, gore or offensive graphical depictions of any kind. Current Features Public Matchmaking Random matchmaking against new or unknown players. Private Matchmaking Private matchmaking against your friends and their friends with a simple Lobby Code. Dedicated Backend FIGHT LIKE HELL has a dedicated back-end where players queue for games. Players log in to Steam but all matches are played on dedicated servers (for both public and private matches).  At the moment all FIGHT HELL HELL matches are hosted in the Europe region. As development continues more servers and regions will be made available. 1 vs 1 Multiplayer Mode Engage in glorious one on one combat against the community or your friends. 2 x Weapons Crush your enemies with simple but deadly accuracy -- or -- set up fast weapon switching combo's for maximum damage per second. 2 x Player Equipment Use your Lighthook to grapple around the map quickly or use your Stealth to gain a tactical advantage over an aggressive enemy. Community Join the FIGHT LIKE HELL Discord Server to stay on top of the latest development progress, get early previews of future content, interact with the developer, report bugs and join the ranks of those who fight like hell! From The Developer Thank you for your early support of the game! The current state of the game leaves a lot to be desired and improvements are being made every week. I invite you to learn more about the game, contribute ideas, provide feedback or even contribute to the game through the FIGHT LIKE HELL Discord Server. Special Thanks A special thank you to the following bands, teams and developers who helped FIGHT LIKE HELL become a reality: LEGION OF THE DAMNED TransIP (Team Blue) Archanor Octamodius Team Suriyun Team Firesplash Entertainment Team Kronnect Team Michsky ChocDino
row.short_description: FIGHT LIKE HELL is a fast-paced FPS where relentless gunplay, fast weapon switching, and good strategy turn every fight into pure (un)controlled chaos. You are the Destroyer, a human soldier now wielding Hell’s abandoned technology after the Devil's defeat in Hell.

row.name: I Wanna Play That Picture Puzzle with Numbers All Day!
row.detailed_description: I want to play that puzzle —where you look at the numbers on the left and top and fill in the intersecting squares—forever! In a rainy café, you can quietly and endlessly immerse yourself in solving puzzles. Solve Puzzles Keep solving puzzles and aim for a streak of correct answers. You can choose board sizes from 5×5 up to 40×30. The soothing sounds of a rainy café and gentle background music will keep you relaxed. Enjoy over 100 Chats Take a break and watch the girls chat on their smartphones. Free to Play This is a completely free game. There are no ads or microtransactions. row.name: Idle Pixel Fantasy
row.detailed_description: 🪙 Get Rich, One Layer at a Time! Idle Pixel Fantasy is a relaxing and addictive idle clicker in pixel style. Recruit hardworking helpers, brave fighters, and magical creatures that automatically collect gold and crystals for you. Invest in stronger units, unlock new layers – and fight your way to the top, where the mighty dragon boss awaits! 🎮 Gameplay Features 💰 Buy units that automatically generate resources: humans, animals, and fantasy creatures 🧱 Unlockable layers – each brings new visual themes and unique units 🔁 Synergy system : Peasants spawn chests Knights attack chests automatically Goblins collect crystals Necromancers boost skeletons 🗺️ The World of Idle Pixel Fantasy Explore and expand your base across multiple themed layers: 🏡 Layer 0 : Village life – Peasants, Cooks, Dogs 🪨 Layer 1 : Rocky world – Miners, Griffins, Spiders ⚰️ Layer 2 : Dungeon – Skeletons, Bats, Necromancers ❄️ Layer 3 : Ice – Fairies, Angels, Spirits 🌋 Layer 4 : Volcano – Demons, Flame creatures 🐉 Final Layer ✨ What Makes It Special? ✅ Everything is saved and loaded automatically – your progress is always safe ✅ Charming pixel art with lovingly animated units ✅ Relaxing gameplay : Play, sit back, and let your resources grow ✅ Synergy instead of standard idle – many units interact cleverly ✅ Steam achievements for extra motivation 👑 Defeat the Dragon! Your ultimate goal: Reach the top layer and defeat the dragon. But to lower its HP, you'll need lots of powerful units. Build, optimize, observe – and conquer the ultimate monster in the final showdown !
row.short_description: Recruit hard-working helpers and magical creatures that automatically collect gold and crystals. Unlock new levels, invest in stronger units, and work your way up to the powerful dragon boss at the top. A relaxing pixel-style idle clicker!

row.name: CRACKED
row.detailed_description: CRACKED is a fast-paced, 3D PvP roguelike where glass-headed mages go head-to-head (or head-to-shards) in chaotic arena duels. Inspired by Rounds and powered by physics-based combat, every fight is unpredictable, explosive, and wildly replayable. Play solo or team up in 1v1 all the way to 4v4 showdowns. After every round, choose from a pool of powerful, quirky upgrades that stack into outrageous builds — from homing fireballs and jet packs to rapid-fire chaos or poison clouds. No two fights are the same. No glass head survives forever. Core Features: 🔮 Team-based Brawling: Battle it out in 1v1 all the way to 4v4 matches. 🧠 Make your build:  with over 40 upgrades of various rarities, make your build your own! 🧪 Concoct your fun: Stack upgrades each round and create broken, over-the-top combos. ⚡ Fast & Fluid Rounds: Jump into short, explosive matches with zero downtime. 🎮 Controller & Online Ready: Built for online competitive fun.
row.short_description: Physics-based wizard brawling! In CRACKED, glass-headed mages duel in chaotic 1v1 to 4v4 battles. Draft absurd upgrades, unleash wild spells, and shatter the competition in this 3D roguelike PvP arena.

row.short_description: Escape into your personal reading sanctuary. Find peace, focus, and productivity.

row.name: MAID MOVING BOXES
row.detailed_description: Quit your job, now an android maid will work in the warehouse instead of you! Maid Moving Boxes is a simple and short game where you have to work... as a box mover. But as a cute anime girl! An engaging physics-based game where you need to meet quotas set by unknown management to load boxes onto cargo ships. Boxes! Boxes, boxes! Boxes have character... they have a price. And they also store many different things - food, chemicals, or even gold. Management expects you to load a certain type of box to complete the given tasks. Or something like that. Your drone assistant cleverly grabs and lifts cargo, if it has enough strength, but you need to be careful and cautious: boxes can break or damage other cargo! In addition to durability, weight, and price, they have... quirks... that can complicate your life. More fun together! We have... a multiplayer mode for you and your friends so you can work in the warehouse together with your colleagues. In multiplayer mode, tasks are generated randomly, which means your shift will last forever! you and your friends can play as much as you want! Upgrades Can't lift the cargo? Weakling. But we have a solution! With honestly earned money, you can buy upgrades that will increase your stats to complete our tasks. Some upgrades will simplify your workflow, while others will diversify it, for example, by unlocking a new way to grab cargo.
row.short_description: An anime android maid and her work drone are meeting a quota at the warehouse! A simple yet engaging game about the monotonous, relaxing process of working as a mover. Short but challenging levels, multiplayer, and lots and lots of boxes await you!

row.name: Real-time Shogi
row.detailed_description: Shogi, the classic Japanese game of strategy, has been reborn. Welcome to Real-Time Shogi, where the ancient board game collides with the blistering speed of modern action games. Forget waiting for your turn. In this game, you and your opponent move your pieces simultaneously in a constant flow of attack and defense. Victory demands more than just deep strategy; it requires quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and the ability to make split-second decisions under pressure. Master the traditional pieces, anticipate your opponent's moves, and unleash your strategy in a dynamic, ever-shifting battlefield. This is a true test of mind and wit, where hesitation means defeat. Are you fast enough to claim checkmate?
row.short_description: Welcome to a world of Shogi freed from the limits of turns. From an infinite number of possibilities, find the shortest path to victory. Your tactical reading and sharp judgment will dominate the board. This is a new challenge for even the most seasoned Shogi fans.

row.name: Click Me Harder
row.detailed_description: Click Me Harder is the ultimate anime girl clicker experience you didn’t know you needed — and probably shouldn’t admit to playing. Start with one lonely anime girl and a dream: to click her. Hard. For money. Every click earns cash. Upgrade your clicks, automate your earnings with idle anime assistants, and snowball your empire into a full-blown waifu industrial complex. Features: Click anime girls. Repeatedly. For profit. Watch numbers get bigger than your love for anime. Build a waifu workforce — Upgrade girls to get more money and points. Idle income so you can “go outside” and still earn money (you won’t). Questionable moral decisions wrapped in cute packaging. Steam Items to collect and trade! Prestige your way to a victory by optionally sacrificing score to the anime overlords for small gain increases! You’re not just clicking. You’re ascending. Wishlist now and prepare to say: “I can stop anytime I want.” Spoiler: you won’t. FAQ :  1. Q: Can I contribute?  A: Yes, just join the discord!  2. Q: Is the point to farm score, money, or steam items? A: Yes. 3. Q: Is this a naughty game?  A: NO, Get your head out of the gutter! 4. Q: Is this a NFT game? A: NO, absolutely not, its a 'Steam Inventory Item' farming game. Steam inventory items pre-date NFTs (came before), although 'NFT's' may have copied a bit from steam items, they are not the same or similar. This game does not use any crypto/blockchain technology and only uses tools provided by Steam. This game doesn't harm your hardware, unlike crypto mining. Steam does not allow crypto/blockchain/NFT games. 5. Q: Why did you use AI for this? A: For programming, it should be obvious that AI is at a point where its nearly impossible to write code that is better AND do it at a rate faster than AI, we are only humans and AI is a good tool for programming. For artwork, this may have been a oversight, but finding artist that expect reasonable rates is harder than you might think. So I'm asking for any community member to join the discord, and comment in the community forums to help us make this game better! 6. Q: I left the game open for 5-10mins still no drops, did you scam me?! A: NO, I took nothing from you first of all. Second of all, the steam drop system is partly developer controlled and partly steam controlled, so sometimes the drop trigger drops nothing, no one has an explanation for why.  This game has a drop trigger every time you open it and every 15min after (unless you decrease it by buying buffs, which can lower it to a 5min loop), expecting items with only 10mins of game time may not work...... Have you thought of possibly opening the game again...? There might be something already waiting for you.... ;) NOTE: Game time is part of my small algorithm, so if you don't get a drop right away, come back, try again, be more patient!
row.short_description: Click anime girls, get money, spend it to get more anime girls.

row.name: Overtime Syndrome - A Late Night Shift Story
row.detailed_description: Experience 'a night of overtime you’ve grown accustomed to' in this ultra-short horror game. But unlike the usual grind, the entire office tonight feels…off, ominous and Strange. Your coworkers are nowhere to be found. The lights are dim. And something — or someone — unknown is lurking. Can you make it until the end of your shift? Overtime Syndrome – A Night Shift Story is a free, ultra-short horror game. In this game, you take on the role of Max , an overworked corporate drone stuck on yet another late-night shift — only this time, something’s not quite right. Strange and unsettling events begin to unfold. As Max, you’ll try to finish your work and make it through the night… hopefully alive. First-Person Horror Experience the night shift from Max’s own eyes. Control Max as you complete tasks, collect items, and follow mysterious leads in the hope of leaving work early — or at least leaving alive. Uncover the Company’s Secrets This decades-old company has a story of its own. In this game, piece together the background of the company, uncover the hidden truth behind its decaying office, and discover the cause of the strange events you’re experiencing. Your Phone is Your Lifeline Who carries a old flashlight everywhere? It’s 2025 — everybody has a smartphone! And when it comes to lighting your way, your phone’s flashlight will be your best friend.
row.short_description: Experience “just another late night shift at the office” in this ultra-short horror game. Somehow this night, the whole office is filled with an eerie, unsettling atmosphere. Missing coworkers, dim lights, and a mysterious presence known only as “it”... Will you make it to the end of your shift?

row.name: I'm Tripping
row.detailed_description: You got high and woke up in the middle of space with a smoke shop to run. No idea how you got here, but aliens are lining up for blunts, bongs, and bizarre substances. Scavenge secondhand marketplaces, find good deals on used items, and flip them to cosmic customers. Grow strange intergalactic plants, manufacture your own drugs, and craft everything from Pre-Rolls to wax pens and edibles. Keep the aliens high, keep the cash flowing. Just don’t forget to trip —every substance is a gamble, every hallucination a game. Some trips will break you. Others will make you rich. Buy a wide range of used items—some can be flipped directly to aliens for quick profit, others serve as key ingredients in drug manufacturing. Learn what’s worth reselling and what’s better cooked into something stronger . Sell. Flip secondhand finds for quick profit or move your own handcrafted stash of intergalactic drugs. Aliens love that stuff—and they pay good money for a good trip. Manufacture. Create everything from Pre-Rolls to potent alien edibles using resources purchased or discovered in unexpected places. Plant.  Grow bizarre intergalactic flora like LSD plants, bong plants, and Pre-Roll plants. You’ll need to get the seeds first—maybe you’ll win them in a high-stakes alien poker game, or score them from shady darknet marketplaces. Trip. The heart of the hustle. Every trip is a high-stakes game—alien poker, spin the bong, mushroom roulette. Bet big, and the aliens will match it. Win rare items to expand your empire… or lose it all in a cosmic flash. What’s it gonna be, hooman?
row.short_description: You woke up high in space with a smoke shop to run. Buy second-hand items from weird intergalactic beings, grow mysterious plants, craft drugs, and flip it all to aliens. From Pre-Rolls to edibles —keep them high, keep the cash flowing. And rule number one: get high on your own supply.
row.notes: This game depicts the use, manufacturing, and sale of illegal substances in a humorous, cartoony, and exaggerated manner. While the themes include drug use and light criminal activity, there is no realistic violence, gore, or sexual content. All visuals are stylized and non-graphic. The game does not contain depictions of self-harm, non-consensual acts, or emotionally distressing scenarios.

row.name: 禍ツ祓イ
row.detailed_description: One day, while tracing old folklore, I heard an intriguing rumor. “On the outskirts of the Higashiyama region, in the village of Mikagura, there is said to be a shrine maiden possessed by an evil spirit.” It sounded like a ridiculous story, but I decided to go to the village to find out if it was true. Mikagura Village— A remote mountain village not even properly marked on maps. Cell phone signals were intermittent, and the village was shrouded in a silence that felt as though time had stopped. Without any guidance, I arrived at a dilapidated shrine on the outskirts of the village. Deep within the shrine, which had not been maintained for years, beyond a door sealed shut like a seal— I encountered a shrine maiden. About this game • This is a choice-based adventure game where you perform an exorcism on a shrine maiden possessed by an evil spirit through torture. • Players use options such as dumplings, whips, and nails to attack the evil spirit. If the attack hits the evil spirit, its HP decreases; if it hits the shrine maiden, her HP decreases. • The game is cleared when the demon's HP reaches 0. If the shrine maiden's HP reaches 0, the game ends. • As days pass, the demon's HP increases.
row.short_description: Let's exorcise the shrine maiden possessed by evil spirits through torture!

row.name: SailFront
row.detailed_description: Take charge of your own dinghy-inspired sailboat in a multiplayer PvP environment! Select from three engaging game modes to sail in: Race, King of the Hill, and Duels. Or, build your own race courses with the custom level editor! SailFront is the first sailing simulator to gamify real sailing mechanics and rules into multiple fun game modes! Here are the current modes available in the beta, with more on the way! Racing Sail in traditional races, going from mark to mark to reach the finish line. Select from pre-existing race courses, or make your own using the race course level designer! During races, real racing rules of sailing are enforced. Just like real races, those that break rules are required to complete penalty turns! King of the Hill Test your rule knowledge and negotiating skills, with the King of the Hill game mode! Fight other players to claim ring zones and be awarded points. Be careful not to break any sailing rules, or you will be expelled outside the ring! Duels Box fight 1v1 until a collision occurs! At that point, the boat with rights wins the duel! Powering all these game modes is SailFront's unique rule system. This system allows players to see, in real time, which boats have sailing rights, and most importantly, why. Because of this info, players who are unfamiliar with the racing rules of sailing can learn them easily! SailFront follows the virtual racing rules of sailing, which contain the most basic sailing rules. Enforcement is achieved through forced penality turns, adding a touch of realism.  In addition to the game modes mentioned above, SailFront includes a course level editor, which allows you to create your own race courses in a matter of minutes! The course editor includes many features that enable you to tailor courses to your preferences. In addition, marks will automatically set themselves to the correct rounding (port or starboard), based on their position in the course. At the heart of SailFront is multiplayer connectivity. Unlike many existing sailing simulators, SailFront offers a lobby-style multiplayer service, where players can create their own public or private servers, and choose which servers they connect to through the join menu. This means you don’t have to wait for mysterious matchmaking to put you into a game, and you can connect with friends in an instant. Feel free to join our Discord server for further updates!
row.short_description: A new type of sailing simulator that brings a fresh interpretation of competitive sailing mechanics, with realistic wind physics! Build your own race courses, play with friends, or explore the large-scale maps!

row.name: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy: Free Appetiser
row.detailed_description: Free Appetiser is a prologue for Diner at the End of the Galaxy, a management game where you run the only diner in a post-apocalyptic galaxy. Learn the basics of running an intergalactic diner, and see just how profitable (or non-profitable!) it can get! Build grand dining halls, busy kitchens, and outdoor gardens where exotic crops thrive. Design a menu that caters to the diverse preferences of your alien clientele. Hire literally anyone who walks through your doors in order to staff your diner with the best cooks, gardeners, servers, and crafters in the Nusa star system. Optimize your interior design to navigate rush hours and hungry guests. Decorate your Diner and sit back and watch your bustling creation come to life as customers pass through. Making customers of different factions happy rewards you with Faction Points that can not only be used to request a visit from their traders, buy special objects and build special rooms - it also allows you to request a faction to invade a region of the galaxy. Earn monthly rewards for each successful invasion you fund! So get started on your galactic diner today! You’ll have tons of tools at your disposal to make your own unique restaurant with your own uniquely weird menu.
row.short_description: Open a diner on a desert planet, grow exotic ingredients, create a menu for intergalactic palates and deal with powerful factions. Free Appetiser is the prologue to Diner at the End of the Galaxy, where you cook and manage your way to intergalactic riches and glory.

row.name: Consumption Line
row.detailed_description: Welcome to your first day at the KindBroth® soup factory! Consumption Line is a short, 100% free, experimental indie game about food systems, industrial production, deceptive advertising, and the erosion of meaning in a world obsessed with efficiency. You play as a factory worker operating two machines: one for broth, one for noodles. Your job is simple: meet your daily quota, follow the recipe, don't ask questions. At first, it feels almost cozy. But as days pass, ingredients change. Machines get faster. Expectations rise. And something about the soup... feels slightly off. Features Short and focused. Playable in one sitting (approx. 30 minutes). Assembly-line gameplay that evolves each day. No game over states, no collectibles, no grind. Just play and think. Unlimited soup! What is this game exactly? This is not a traditional game. There are no skill trees, boss fights, or deep systems. It's a tightly scoped, 30-minute experience meant to invite reflection. Over the course of five in-game days, your routine remains the same: leave your flat, take the subway, arrive at the production line, hit your quota, go home... Yet there are some changes, some funny and some bleak, that reveal issues in the world around you. Fully free! Consumption Line is 100% free and also ad-free. It was created as a personal, 'artsy' project to explore our relationship with ultra-processed foods, misleading marketing, and the ruthlessness of capitalism.
row.short_description: 'Consumption Line' is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.

row.name: WhatJustFlashed
row.detailed_description: Helps track and detail each console popup, so you can ensure they're not malicious. As long as it's running, it will capture and keep a list of the most recent console popups. On click, displays which application is responsible, where it's located, what arguments were used, and more.
row.short_description: Displays the most recent console popups.

row.name: Realms of Reverie
row.detailed_description: Have you ever wanted to step into a quiet world shaped by myth and memory? Realm of Reverie is a short VR adventure game developed in Unreal Engine 5. Explore and interact with simple puzzles in this short student game. After a disaster leaves a sacred village in ruins, you awaken as the spirit of its last priest. Explore the remnants, gather lost energy, and restore the shattered Sun Stone. Inspired by artifacts from Mexico’s National Museum of Anthropology, this 10-minute journey offers gentle exploration and a moment of quiet reflection. Realm of Reverie is the product of two person team Maggie Lin and Yichen Xiong for Senior Thesis 2025.

row.detailed_description: Cuber is a low-poly endless runner game in which you have to keep an ice cube alive. There are many obstacles, as well as items that influence the effect of the obstacles. Designed as a rich and evolving single-player experience, Cardygon challenges you to master both synergy and collection. BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE DECK With over 80 unique cards at launch, every match is a new puzzle to solve. Discover devastating combos, combine the skills of characters from different worlds, and build a deck that reflects your unique playstyle. A RICH AND EVOLVING SOLO ADVENTURE Progress through a captivating story mode and feel a true sense of progression as you unlock new card packs every step of the way. But the adventure doesn't end there! Once the story is complete, the real challenge begins with Crossover Mode, offering much tougher and more strategic battles to test the limits of your deck. THREE GAME MODES, THREE WAYS TO FIGHT Beyond the main campaign, jump into quick matches with 3 distinct rule sets for endless variety: Classic Mode: Eliminate all enemy characters with the help of powerful support cards. Rapid Mode: The first player to eliminate 3 characters wins! Original Mode: Only your characters matter. No support deck, just pure strategy! ONE GAME, YOUR PLATFORMS Play where you want, when you want! Cardygon is available on Windows, Linux, and even Android. And that's just the beginning: get ready for the arrival of cross-platform cloud saves and competitive cross-platform PvP, allowing you to continue your adventure and face players on any device. SHOW OFF YOUR ACHIEVEMENTS! Cardygon is built for challengers and completionists! Customize your in-game profile by unlocking unique titles like 'Collector' or 'Legendary' to prove your mastery. AN EVER-EVOLVING UNIVERSE Cardygon is a living game that will grow with you. We are committed to providing you with regular, high-quality content. Here is the game's roadmap: 🔗 Cross-platform Online (LAN + competitive PVP) ☁️ Cross-platform cloud save 🌟 New rarity with animated illustrations 🎮 New game mode (Survival, etc...) 📅 Daily missions and varied challenges 🤝 Unexpected collaborations!
row.short_description: Cardygon is a 100% single-player strategic deckbuilder. Collect 80+ cards from the Batpolygon universe crossover. Devise powerful strategies, customize your profile, and build the ultimate deck!

row.name: FlipSum - A Puzzle By Claris Richter
row.detailed_description: FlipSum is a bold new twist on classic number puzzles! Inspired by sudoku, this brain-teasing series challenges you to flip, cancel, and balance numbers on a grid to match the target totals. It’s a thrilling game of logic, deduction, and number play—perfect for puzzle lovers who crave something fresh and clever. Get ready to see numbers in a whole new light! How To Play: Mark numbers as positive, negative, or cancel them out. Only one number may be cancelled per row / column. Can you balance the entire grid so that each column / row adds up to the correct number? Features: 4 Difficulty Levels Infinite Puzzles Level Counter Per Difficulty Track Your Total Points To Show Off To Your Friends!

row.name: Land Run
row.detailed_description: LandRun is a one-man strategy card game with a motif of the land scramble 'landrun' from the western frontier era. Players, as black slaves, participate in 'Land Run Tournament' because of their owners' greed, and if they win, they will get the freedom they promised and the land they want. This piece is a personalized title developed for PCs, using Unity. Unlike the typical Trump game, except for five special cards, it is designed so that the impact of number size does not appear significantly. When a player hands one card, his or her horse advances one space in the opponent's direction, and when the horse crosses the opponent's boundary, the attack succeeds. Successful three times in this attack will result in victory in that round. The key strategy is to plan in which order to use the card and move the horse, with items that reverse the opponent's advance, move several spaces at once, or adjust the timing of crossing the boundary line. In addition, if the boundary breakthrough does not occur three times until the deck is exhausted, the score is calculated by adding the sum of the number of cards left in the hand and the sum of the unused physical strength cards, and the sum is used to determine victory or defeat. As a result, there are two winning plans: a direct attack victory that breaks through the opponent's boundaries three times and finishes quickly, and a score victory that is aimed at managing hand and physical strength while looking at the deck run out. It is up to the player to decide which plan to choose, and it is important to strategically adjust the timing of using the item, the consumption of the physical card, and how much handwriting you will leave. Another feature of the game is that there is still room for a turnaround even in unfavorable situations due to various items. Matches are played in a tournament format. Players will face several contestants in a row under the direction of their owners, each with a different disposition: 'the type who pushes aggressively from the beginning' and 'the type who saves items and special cards and then flips them all at once in the second half.' The rules are the same, but they are designed to vary depending on who you face, whether you are aiming for an attack victory or a point victory. A round can take approximately 10 to 15 minutes, and the game is designed to allow you to find your own winning pattern by re-attempting several times in a short period of time. It uses a simple mouse-only interface. The game is played by simply selecting a card, but the weight of the judgment varies depending on how you read the horse's location, the number of cards left, and the remaining physical strength of the card. We aim to design it as intuitive as possible so that even players who are not confident in numerical calculation can strategize with the image of 'move forward, step back, push away.' In terms of visuals and world views, in order to give an epic reason to the rule of 'why fight each other to move forward first,' we tried to superimpose Landrun in real history with the situation of 'who runs first and takes the land.' The board and UI are motifs of desolate land maps, old gambling tables, and bulletin boards in bars, and we tried to direct the main character to feel like he is getting closer to freedom and the ground whenever the horse advances one by one. It is a game created by black slaves who are forced to fight for their owners, conscious of twisting the contradictions and madness of the Western Pioneering Era and Landrun through the structure that they try to win their freedom in the end within the same rules and tournament.
row.short_description: An original single-play card game set in the 'LandRun' of the Western Pioneering Era. A fierce psychological battle using cards and luck, the game is turned upside down with just one card.

row.detailed_description: Alpha Point is a next-generation, solo-indie masterpiece: a realistic, competitive multiplayer FPS packed with action, grit, and community... Whew, that's a lot of adjectives. Stunning Ray-Traced Graphics: Experience cutting-edge visuals with highly optimized ray tracing, delivering lifelike lighting and reflections on a solo-indie budget. Fluid Movement & Gunplay:  Master intuitive mechanics with responsive shooting, nostalgic movement, and tactical sprinting for never-ending, heart-pounding action. Innovative Rank & Loadout System: Climb ranks through your wins, earn Tags to unlock weapons and characters, or risk it all to prestige for the rank boost you deserve. Go bankrupt and you'll be back at square one. Diverse Gameplay Modes: Free-For-All: Eliminate every rival in sight. Bloodiest hands win. Team Deathmatch: Team up to outgun the enemy. Coordination is your edge. Capture the Flag: Steal the enemy flag while defending your own. Strategy is key. The Survival Games [ New! ] : Collect gear and compete to be the last man standing. With more on the way... Five Unique Maps: Battle across meticulously crafted arenas designed for intense firefights. Eleven Distinct Weapons: From assault rifles to snipers to shotguns, customize the loadout that suits you best. Local Voice Chat: Strategize with teammates and taunt foes in real-time. Robust Anti-Cheat: Non-intrusive protection built into the code itself. Bartholomew... The times of war are upon us, and the Alpha Squad needs you. Feel the thrill of the high-stakes, innovative Rank & Loadout system, where every match is a gamble on your future. Victory will progress your rank and earn you Tags, your currency for unlocking powerful weapons and unique characters. Defeat , on the other hand, will cost you Tags and set you back in the ranks. Play it safe to build your arsenal, or push aggressively for glory . The choice is yours. Purchase enough weapons, and you'll gain the ability to Prestige , giving you the rank promotion you deserve, but at the cost of resetting your Loadout for a challenge anew. Run out of Tags entirely? You'll face Bankruptcy , wiping your Loadout clean and setting you back in the ranks. Alpha Point's Rank & Loadout system rewards skill, strategy, and nerve, making every kill meaningful in your non-stop fight for survival. Built by a passionate solo developer, Alpha Point is a living project shaped by community feedback, with additional planned content already coming your way. Join the fight, wishlist now, and head to the Alpha Point -- your squad is calling.

row.name: EGO :: Exit Protocol
row.detailed_description: You awaken in an unfamiliar place with no memory. With no clue where the escape lies, you find yourself trapped in an endless time loop where your past actions accumulate as fragments of memory. By gathering these pieces, you uncover your true identity and seek the key to escape. EGO :: Exit Protocol is a 2D narrative adventure game focused on exploration and puzzle-solving without combat. Players restore memories and progress by collecting clues and solving puzzles, leading to two different possible endings based on their choices and discoveries. This game was inspired by the 'EGO' chapter of GOINGSEVENTEEN.
row.short_description: 'EGO :: Exit Protocol' is a 2D narrative adventure game where the protagonist awakens in an unfamiliar building with no memory and must collect clues through repeating cycles to uncover a way to escape.

Jump, glide and puzzle your way across the ocean floor to find the lost stone tablets to take on corrupted foes and restore peace to the sea! Jump. glide and explore! Jump and glide your way across two colorful areas - the Reef and the Ruins.  Collect!   Explore the levels to find pearls and stone tablets.
